subject: Plenty in the tank
body:
Jesse James putting in thousands of miles with more to come. | | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/mullenformontana/plenty-in-the-tank?e=805e709ff8)
---
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=0dc154b92c&e=805e709ff8)
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=22bf2503a2&e=805e709ff8)
Hey team, it’s Jesse James Mullen, and I’m on the road next week.
I’m grabbing a bag and hopping behind the wheel for another 1,000-mile road trip up to the hi-line on Monday morning. Then I’m moving on to central Montana and pulling back into Deer Lodge during the early hours of Friday morning.
**Four days, four nights on the road, meeting with Montanans.**
**I’m no stranger to long highway miles.** Since launching this campaign, I put more than 20,000 miles on my rig. That’s a lot of gas, and this mode of transport doesn’t run on hay like some others do.
[](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=4788a1a70b&e=805e709ff8)
In more ways than one, running this campaign is a throwback to the days of my youth. Piling into a car with a few others, crashing with friends, or staying at cheap hotels so we don’t waste hard-earned dollars (dollars that buy air time and roadside signs).
Like those road trips from our youth, I’m asking others to chip in a few bucks to fill the gas tank.
If this email raises $200, that’s gasoline handled next week. If we raise $1,000, that gets me in front of voters statewide for a month.
[**Will you chip in $5?**](https://jessejamesmullen.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=ead1108518cb8f41430a7b0b3&id=8d4c6a2877&e=805e709ff8)
Thank you, it means more than you know,Jesse James Mullen

body:
They want to silence me for exposing their abuses of power
| | [ ](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=a94f59c3d2a5480b866ae93629af002d&_e=Leo72MTgz5xoafXJvGCDqNG_-4VYuKUwT0cXcNc7JNxbj_u-Pg1tTM1hWEUovvRGwrIxzOZPp3u3ixOcAB3Uj-gllqUoNQ3ziP45XWUUFXetqD3YkWZV8dCvxJHwUsR_QzLrEm7otXQC_fzGoexhf5Opa2RqH9SeIZbjylY7lbsLpVTOunODdjzi_H7VNM-dGOSrVdhO9LRKAGdwStjYCymfSO4M4KxwhylZ92I7-LBdPOkoaToN1gNwIPUOvBP8xoL4EeT8o_IhaCp58GRjKRyTvJ3ppFsWWVSESU3YBAgdB7NCy3CVsKqer1G-ID7LSY7EHdXx6uWml7KTv9h-zg%3D%3D)
---
Fellow American, this is an all hands on deck moment. Dan Goldman, a Radical Democrat Congressman who called for President Trump to be "eliminated", has filed a motion to censure me in the House. America Last politicians in DC like Congressman Goldman are desperately smearing me because I continually uncover how Democrats suffering from Trump Derangement Syndrome are abusing their power to go after President Trump and conservatives. They know that I will not back down in the fight for election integrity and I will not cease exposing the Left's weaponization of our federal government against Joe Biden's opponents. **It is clear that House Democrats want to silence me because I pose a threat to their power and make no mistake, unless we stand up to these corrupt swamp creatures, they will attempt to remove me from the House.** Democrats simply cannot afford to have a spotlight on their failures and corruption before the 2024 election. _The more I uncover the more I am under fire because unless they find a way to silence House Republicans like me they know they will not be able to avoid accountability._
| [ **DEFEND ELISE** ](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=a94f59c3d2a5480b866ae93629af002d&_e=Leo72MTgz5xoafXJvGCDqNG_-4VYuKUwT0cXcNc7JNxbj_u-Pg1tTM1hWEUovvRGwrIxzOZPp3u3ixOcAB3Uj-gllqUoNQ3ziP45XWUUFXetqD3YkWZV8dCvxJHwUsR_QzLrEm7otXQC_fzGoexhf5Opa2RqH9SeIZbjylY7lbt8V-XI25gNBFEIYscJp8yrJgQ_KzRzAMOyziDrO4_6ZKsX-_Va9fNgC0Bl0sx9NMkNV0QCGjyPg2uR6OmCvxVCyKDAWeyg8MbCO4y0SOadjv-O9IDyr7AZyOWxeMOSg84rxHL2akviOnbd8pO70ZBToqj7oSH7_2AFyko6sk8TsQ%3D%3D)
---
Fellow American, the truth is I would not be able to fight back unless I had the support of fellow conservatives which is why I am grateful to have the support of patriots from my district, from across my home state of New York, and from every corner of our country. [**I am calling on that support now because I have never needed reinforcements more than at this moment****.**](http://links.gopmembership.com/u/click?_t=e3c9a4cac7f248a39c2a3d920479a441&_m=a94f59c3d2a5480b866ae93629af002d&_e=Leo72MTgz5xoafXJvGCDqNG_-4VYuKUwT0cXcNc7JNxbj_u-Pg1tTM1hWEUovvRGwrIxzOZPp3u3ixOcAB3Uj-gllqUoNQ3ziP45XWUUFXetqD3YkWZV8dCvxJHwUsR_QzLrEm7otXQC_fzGoexhf5Opa2RqH9SeIZbjylY7lbt5w770bn6_44maf8YnKeBX_B0SZk9Z7z2jCQR4_FusNQAPlu0aovnVPHpbFHaf3M5OB-4fCg6Szgjdx7PZrYtRDDnHLK7wxZ3QPoxxC3-SusnzNdTcuAyQzySZv_t0UD9dyyrH7tIFlEV7cl9VQY8D-aCjdVBXKrV8Vtv1e6z8XA%3D%3D) I know that the Democrat smear machine targeting me is well funded and has the resources to launch an all out assault against me and all America First conservatives who pose a threat to the Biden Administration. name: Elizabeth Warren
subject: Did you watch any live TV on Monday?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Warren for Senate
body:
Playoff football, the Emmys, and what happened at the Iowa caucuses.

| | | [ ](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/216?t=3&akid=1901%2E4032634%2EoyivIE)
---
Did you watch any live TV on Monday night? Maybe either of the playoff games? (Here’s hoping that next year is the Pats’ year.) Maybe the Emmys? (The public school teacher in me was rooting for Abbott Elementary!) Or maybe you tuned in to the live results from the Iowa caucuses. If you decided to preserve your peace of mind by tuning out that third option, I can’t blame you. They were less suspenseful than the Emmys or playoff football. Donald Trump ran away with a big win early on, continuing his glide path to the Republican nomination for president. Trump’s victory in Iowa is another reminder that we must directly face the reality of what we’re up against this year, and what’s on the line. If Republicans gain enough power, they’ll pass a nationwide abortion ban — overriding any and all state-level protections, like what we’ve got in Massachusetts. Trump has already promised to try to repeal the Affordable Care Act again, which would rip health coverage away from millions of Americans. And the very survival of our democracy is at stake if our next president is an election denier charged with 91 criminal offenses who’s said he’d be a dictator on day one. **The 2024 elections are critically important to our freedoms as a people and the future of our country for our children and grandchildren. I’m running for re-election to keep fighting for Massachusetts families and help make sure Democrats hold our majority in the U.S. Senate.** **Because if we keep the Senate, keep the White House, and flip the GOP’s slim-as-can-be House majority, we can make real progress on the policies this team is fighting for, from ensuring universal child care to guaranteeing the right to an abortion to getting the rich and powerful to pay a fair share.** [**Can you make a donation of $28 or any amount to fuel our campaign and fight for the big, structural change we need as a nation?**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1145?amount=28&t=8&akid=1901%2E4032634%2EoyivIE)

---
The contrast will be clear this year — as long as we get out and make the case. As president, Donald Trump stacked the Supreme Court to overturn Roe v. Wade, handed massive tax breaks to billionaires and giant corporations, and stoked an insurrection. As president, Joe Biden has capped the cost of insulin for millions of Americans at $35, passed a historic investment in the fight against climate change (paid for in part by my minimum corporate profits tax), cracked down on wealthy tax cheats, cut junk fees — the list goes on. In fact, his administration JUST announced a plan to slash overdraft fees to as little as $3, which can save consumers billions of dollars a year — the Consumer Financial Protection Bureau is getting ready to make it happen! Democrats have a real record to run on. And I’m running for re-election because there’s a whole lot more we need to do. We need to tackle the housing affordability crisis. Make sure all working parents can get quality, affordable child care. Pass a wealth tax to fund opportunity for all of our kids. Enshrine reproductive freedom into federal law and overturn the cruel abortion bans Republicans have enacted at the state level. Root corruption out of Washington. I’m in this fight all the way — and I’m grateful you’ve fought by my side. [**If you’re able to keep up the fight by making a financial contribution at this time, it would go a long way right now — this is the part of campaign season where potential GOP opponents are sizing us up to decide whether to get in the race.**](https://act.elizabethwarren.com/go/1145?amount=28&t=14&akid=1901%2E4032634%2EoyivIE) But I never expect you to donate to every email, and I’m always honored to have you on the team. When we link arms, we make each other stronger. Truly. Thanks for being a part of this, Elizabeth

Now, he’s using his power to go even further.
#
Peter — Josh Hawley’s crusade to overturn Roe v. Wade had a direct and major impact on the extreme, total abortion ban Missouri immediately enacted after the Supreme Court’s decision in June 2022.
And now, he’s using his power to go _even further._ **Please let me explain:**
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43011?refcode=em20240118-4636&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4636%2E614464%2E0Ry-kk)
**[PROTECT ABORTION ACCESS](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43011?refcode=em20240118-4636&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=2&akid=4636%2E614464%2E0Ry-kk)**
Hawley was on a mission to criminalize abortion even before he was elected to the U.S. Senate in 2018. But once he got to DC, he leveraged his new position and power into a family business dedicated to banning abortion in all forms and in all 50 states.
**First, he corrupted our courts with judges like Matthew Kacsmaryk** — a donor to Hawley’s 2018 campaign who faced bipartisan opposition during his confirmation process due to his Big Brother views on contraception and personal freedoms. Hawley forced through Kacsmaryk’s confirmation anyway.
**Then, Hawley used his taxpayer-funded office to support his wife’s efforts as an activist attorney in the Dobbs case to overturn Roe.** Missouri became the first state to ban abortion just moments after the Supreme Court’s decision to strike it down.
**And now, Hawley is supporting her efforts to ban the most commonly used abortion medication, mifepristone, nationwide** — a suit decided by Hawley’s donor judge, that we recently learned will be reviewed by the Supreme Court.
[](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43011?refcode=em20240118-4636&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=3&akid=4636%2E614464%2E0Ry-kk)
**[PROTECT ABORTION ACCESS](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43011?refcode=em20240118-4636&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=4&akid=4636%2E614464%2E0Ry-kk)**
**I’m running to defeat Josh Hawley because everyday Missourians deserve a Senator who will stand up and fight for their personal freedoms** — not another politician who’s obsessed with using their own power to control our bodies, families, and lives.
If recent wins for abortion rights and red-state Democrats in Kentucky and Ohio tell us anything, it’s that we have a real opportunity to hold Hawley accountable and protect abortion access in Missouri this year. And with news today of the effort to add a constitutional amendment to the 2024 ballot to enshrine abortion rights in Missouri, we’ve got the coalition to make it happen.
**But it won’t be possible without your help, Peter, so I’m asking:**
**[Will you please split a donation of $10 or whatever you can afford between my grassroots campaign and Missourians for Constitutional Freedom today? Together, we can defeat Josh Hawley, end Missouri’s extreme abortion ban, and take this Senate seat back for everyday people.](https://act.lucaskunce.com/go/43011?refcode=em20240118-4636&firstname=Peter&lastname=Willis&email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=18326&city=Cresco&state=PA&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=5&akid=4636%2E614464%2E0Ry-kk)**

body:
If lobbyists want to meet with me, they better bring their good ideas, not their checkbooks
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=36671%2E3422442%2EpgPaw6)
Derek, I’m the only Democrat in this race who has never taken a dime of corporate PAC money and doesn’t take contributions from federal lobbyists. **Here’s the story behind it.**
A few years ago I attended a reception for newly elected Members in DC. A lobbyist came up to me and said “Well, I guess you’re one of the new Members we’ll never see.” I asked him why. He said it was because I didn’t take corporate PAC money.
**Since that day, I’ve said clearly—if lobbyists want to meet with me, they better bring their good ideas, not their checkbooks.** I fully support banning corporate PAC and federal lobbyist contributions, because Americans shouldn’t question who their elected officials are really working for.
But until we pass serious campaign finance reform, **every Member of Congress has a choice to make when it comes to corporate PAC money.** As elected leaders, we’re privileged to be in positions of power, and we should use our power to stand up to the status quo and corporate special interests.
Californians deserve to know that their Senator works for _them_. Whether it’s using my whiteboard to hold Wall Street CEOs accountable or passing legislation to prevent Big Pharma from raising prices, I’m proud to fight for working people.
Our campaign is funded by real people, and our average contribution this week is $21. ## Currently, America isn’t playing to win.
Howdy Peter,

**NEWS FLASH. We are quickly losing our competitive edge economically and militarily. After 7 decades of America using the same “Democracy First” playbook, our adversaries have memorized our every move.**
Imagine that as a head football coach, you use the same playbook, formations, hand signals, and decision-making matrix for 70 years without any variation. Do you think for one minute that your opponent won’t know exactly what you’re going to do and exactly when you’re going to do it?
**Why do you think the wars in Korea, Vietnam, Iraq, Afghanistan, Syria, Yemen, Libya, and Ukraine all lasted so long?**
**Why couldn’t the United States, the most powerful country in the history of the planet, win a decisive victory in any of these wars?**
**The answer is simple: our objective was purely ideological, not practical.**
If we want to maintain our edge over China, then we need to stop driving countries like Russia, Iran, and North Korea farther into China’s camp simply because they do not align with our democratic values. We need to start pulling China’s allies more toward the center and realign our own alliances to maximize our economic and military edge over China.
**My stances on current foreign policy issues:**
1. I do not support U.S. funding or fighting for Ukraine’s defense.
2. Israel is sovereign and free to do as it wishes.
3. I do not support U.S. funding or fighting for Israel.
4. The U.S. should pull troops out of the Middle East.
5. The U.S. must become energy independent.
6. The U.S. must become semi-conductor independent.
7. Alliances should be more practical and less ideological.

May God Bless America.
Jared Lovelace

name: Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
subject: "Nothing to worry about"
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez for Congress
body:
#
Alexandria’s community sent her to Congress on purpose to disrupt and challenge a lot of what’s wrong in D.C.
But during her first term, many people in her own party said her election was a fluke, a mistake, and that there was “nothing to worry about.” Many believed that Alexandria would be a one-term Congresswoman.

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77323973/450112722/374581606?amount=15&source=EM_NBI_AB_20240118_FR_1.1_6MO_campaign_NA_NA_newsletter&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjEvMS85MDU3OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5OWMyNmJiOC03NGI2LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=TD6YUPrvEENMM-J-Hwq-QkoqnKlwngxULYeGNKzEpaw=) | **→ In February, Ami reintroduced legislation to simplify Health Care enrollment.** As the former Chief Medical Officer for Sacramento County, Ami is committed to make health care accessible to all families. This bill will allow Americans to enroll in coverage as they file their tax returns. This bill is essential to helping the millions of Americans that are still uninsured because of the barriers of enrollment.

**→ Ami reintroduced the bipartisan HERO Act to ensure that our country’s first responders and health care workers have access to mental health resources.** Our first responders deal with dangerous and traumatic situations everyday serving our communities. They face an elevated risk of suicide and we owe it them to provide the support and assistance that they deserve.

**→ Ami helped introduce a bill to ensure insurance companies fully cover over-the-counter birth control without any out-of-pocket costs.** With the FDA’s historic approval of the first-ever over-the-counter birth control pill, our next step is to guarantee it is affordable for all. As a doctor, Ami is determined to safeguard reproductive rights, especially as they continue to come under attack from the far-right.

**→ Ami secured millions in federal funding for an expansion project at the Sacramento International Airport.** Ami wants to foster accessibility. These funds enhance and modernize the airport infrastructure for all travelers.

**→ By the end of 2023, Ami's office surpassed $17 million in earned federal benefits owed to Sacramento County families.** Since 2013, Ami’s office has worked to resolve thousands of cases to make sure residents were given the proper assistance.

**→ Ami secured $32 million for the 2023 fiscal year funding infrastructure, water and community safety projects.** Ami knows it is essential to strengthen our local economy and invest in our local businesses and families.

**→ Ami’s bipartisan End TB Now Act of 2023 unanimously passed the House Foreign Affairs Committee.** Tuberculosis is a leading infectious disease killer worldwide, killing nearly 2 million people in 2021. As a doctor, Ami has witnessed the devastating impact of the disease and is dedicated to eradicating tuberculosis globally.

body:
[https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif] Friends — A Republican multi-millionaire just announced her campaign to defeat Martin in New Mexico’s U.S. Senate race. [https://als-totem.s3.amazonaws.com/core/spacer.gif]
Martin’s new challenger is a longtime hedge fund executive who has already poured half a million dollars into her own campaign. As the daughter of New Mexico’s last Republican Senator, she is all but certain to have GOP mega-donors lining up to support her bid. She already has the full backing of the National Republican Senatorial Committee.
While Martin’s opponent may have a personal fortune and the GOP establishment behind her, what we have is far more valuable: a grassroots movement that comes together to fight for our shared values time and time again.
That’s why we’re reaching out today: We need to raise as much as possible in these first 48 hours to prepare for the spending Republicans are about to pour into New Mexico. Will you rush in a split contribution of $5 or any amount between our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand to help keep Martin in the Senate? [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_heinrich?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your split donation between Martin Heinrich and Kirsten Gillibrand will go through immediately:

DONATE ANOTHER AMOUNT [secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_heinrich?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
We can’t afford to lose Martin’s voice in the Senate. The issues that matter most to our movement are at stake, from preserving our public lands and waters to protecting critical benefits like Medicare and Social Security.
But this race is officially competitive, and we need to build up our grassroots resources immediately to win. Between Martin’s new opponent jumping in and Donald Trump planning to ramp up his campaign in New Mexico, it’s clear Republicans are making the Land of Enchantment a top target this year.
We have our work cut out for us in the months ahead. Please help us defend Martin’s seat in New Mexico from his new challenger by splitting a grassroots contribution of $5 or any amount now between our campaign and Kirsten Gillibrand>> [https://secure.actblue.com/contribute/page/gfs_heinrich?amounts=5,25,50,100,250]
Thank you for helping keep Martin where he belongs — in the U.S. Senate fighting for a brighter future for New Mexico.
— Heinrich HQ

body:
Friends, we wanted to make sure you saw John’s email from yesterday because this deadline is just too important.
__ | | | Friends – We wanted to make sure you saw John’s email from yesterday because this deadline is just too important. Fellow American,

Care, no matter what.

This is the motto of Planned Parenthood. While it sounds great on the surface, Planned Parenthood is lying to itself, to vulnerable women and young girls, and to the American people through manipulative and dangerously subtle language.

While they claim to provide healthcare services to women no matter who they are or where they live, abortion can never be healthcare. Further, while they claim to provide numerous services to women, 97.2% of Planned Parenthood’s pregnancy resolution services are devoted to abortions, the purposeful ending of an unborn baby’s life.

**[Does 97.2% of cases brought to Planned Parenthood that end in the death of an innocent child sound like “care” to you?](http://trk.faithandlibertymail.com/c/7/eyJhaSI6OTkyNjA2OTcsImUiOiJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSIsInJpIjoiMTM1MDI1NTcxMSIsInJxIjoiMDItYjI0MDE5LTQ5Yzg0YmQ5ODliMjQyMjZhMzllZTY5NzhmNDBjZTU4IiwicGgiOm51bGwsIm0iOmZhbHNlLCJ1aSI6IjEiLCJ1biI6IiIsInUiOiJodHRwczovL2FjdGlvbi5zYmFwcm9saWZlLm9yZy9wbGFubmVkLXBhcmVudGhvb2Q_dXRtX2NhbXBhaWduPXN0YW5kX2FnYWluc3RfcGxhbm5lZF9wYXJlbnRob29kJnV0bV9zb3VyY2U9cHJvc3BlY3RpbmcmdXRtX21lZGl1bT1lbWFpbCZhcHBlYWxfaWQ9MTAxOCZwYWNrYWdlX2lkPTI1NTQ2JnV0bV9jb250ZW50PUFFX0ZBTFI0NTczMyJ9/7MMxNQmeuspNkjAeSvIS_g)**

Planned Parenthood cares only about the business. It preys on the vulnerable, thrives on women’s fear, and fuels itself on greed. When a woman arrives seeking answers to an unexpected pregnancy, the clock to gain a profit starts ticking. They will do whatever they can to make a woman agree to an abortion because each abortion completed is more profit in their pockets.

name: Your America
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Your America News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38203%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=10LYwPEBqWbvS4FxMMoSWA&sysid=1) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College’s **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration’s weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That’s why I’m asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38204%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RQc2jXNavGJ0k1GqjKckZg&sysid=1)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today’s ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America’s great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America’s leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include “The Politicization of the Department of Justice” by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we’ve seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38204%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=RQc2jXNavGJ0k1GqjKckZg&sysid=1)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale’s educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |
---

name: Karen Dabney
subject: My son's case is moving to trial
body:
I’ve never done something like this before.

Friend,

I've never done something like this before.

But right now my family is up against more than we can handle on our own. And there's nothing I won't do to protect my family - even ask a perfect stranger for help.

Next month, my beloved son - former Deputy James Johnson of the Williamson County, TX Sheriff's Department - will go on trial for manslaughter.

He faces decades in prison for doing his job by the book.

This is a photo of James with his son.
[](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z39flencjaei70nuobebi1mvea57h2c38d8puj2g_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cdhm4o31clh2bs)
James dreamed of being a police officer ever since he took his first "ride-along" in a cop car at the age of 18.

How could we know back then that one day he would find himself the target of a nationwide political movement directed and financed by radical anti-cop billionaire George Soros?

**[If you're sick of our men and women in blue being targeted by anti-cop prosecutors, then I pray you'll find it in your heart to help my son today.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zshpvcigvk8c4f5rghufi1qake51qqr1ej6m4bvg_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cdhm4o31clh2bs)**

Please let me explain...

On the night of March 28, 2019, my son conducted a routine traffic stop.

But instead of pulling over, the driver - a convicted drug dealer named Javier Ambler - floored the gas and tried to flee.

The suspect's speed quickly exceeded 100 miles per hour. Along the way, he collided with signs, trees, fences, and other roadside objects.

The chase lasted for 22 minutes and spanned two counties. At any moment, another driver or a pedestrian could have been struck and killed by the drug dealer's reckless driving. It was a deadly serious situation.

Eventually, the chase ended when the suspect crashed head-first into a tree.

My son ordered him to get on the ground at gunpoint. He refused. James ordered again, and still the driver did not comply.

That's when another Deputy and an Austin Police Officer arrived on scene. Together, they tried to handcuff the giant man - but he kept resisting and fighting to get back on his feet.

Now, my son is strong. . . but this man was twice his size. . . **nearly 400 pounds.** And even together, the three officers could not subdue him.

So, to put a stop to his fighting and get him handcuffed, they deployed a taser again.

Still nothing - he kept resisting.

They tased him once more and they were finally able to get him into handcuffs.

That's when they noticed that the suspect had lost consciousness. Without missing a beat, they immediately began life-saving tactics and radioed for an ambulance to respond with high priority.

The suspect was rushed to the hospital - but despite the prompt medical attention, he was declared dead on arrival.

According to the medical examiner, Javier Ambler's "morbid obesity" had given him "congestive heart failure" and "hyper intensive cardiovascular disease," - which, in the heat of the struggle, caused his death.

Soon after, an internal affairs investigation by my son's department found that the deputies did nothing wrong. A second independent investigation by the Austin Police Department concluded my son and the other officers committed no such crimes and did not cause Ambler's death.

**But two years after being cleared, James was charged with manslaughter!**

So what changed?

Well, Travis County - where the suspect crashed and the chase concluded - elected a new District Attorney.

A George Soros-funded District Attorney . . . a Bernie Sanders and Elizabeth Warren-endorsed District Attorney . . . a socialist District Attorney, who campaigned not on fighting crime - but on cracking down on police.

His name is Jose Garza, and in just over three years in office, he's charged dozens of cops with crimes while letting countless violent criminals go free!

Somehow, my son James got caught up in something much bigger than himself, and now he's lost his job and his life savings trying to defend his good name in court.

Worst of all, if convicted James's children will lose their dad to decades in prison.

**[Now I hope you can see why I'm swallowing my pride and asking you to help me fight for my son - and my grandchildren - by supporting James' legal defense.](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2zeqkidpb2o1ss56ev71nvie6mlv7a78o529q7up0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cdhm4o31clh2bs)**

You see, right when we thought all hope was lost - we got a call from Jason Johnson at the Law Enforcement Legal Defense Fund (LELDF).

This incredible organization helps innocent cops who are unfairly prosecuted for split-second, life-or-death decisions they make in the line of duty.

They provide legal counsel, expert witnesses. . . whatever is needed to make sure wrongly accused police officers get a fair shake in court.

And they do it all free of charge!

They're funded entirely by the generous support of big-hearted donors like you, who can recognize a miscarriage of justice. . . and want to help fix it.

My son has told me he feels abandoned by the people he dedicated his life to helping. I told him there are people out there who still support the police...

...and I pray you are one of these people and that you will step up and help to fund the $150,000+ in legal fees he's facing.

**[Will you please help my son clear his name by making a generous tax-deductible donation of $35, $50, $100 or more to LELDF today?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3k38v2abapgudog8lpr5a4m8m98h5fvuo653fk8_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cdhm4o31clh2bs)**

No matter how much you can give to help LELDF fund James' defense, I hope you'll know how grateful I - and my entire family - will be for your help.

With deep appreciation,

**Karen Dabney**

P.S. My son has four children of his own. If James is convicted and receives the maximum sentence of 20 years, they'll be grown adults by the time he's finally set free. He will miss out on everything. And his children will grow up without a dad.

**[So, please- PLEASE - won't you send the best donation you can today to help keep my brave son out of prison and with his children, where he belongs?](http://e.1600daily.com/rd/9z2z3muu9mqn1rvq1qtpaedb521fo6fa7q7mplk2kug_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cdhm4o31clh2bs)** Thank you, from the bottom of my heart, THANK YOU!
\----------------

_More such officers who sacrifice so much for will face similar fates unless we speak out and stand up for the brave men and women in blue. The next time you see a police officer in your community, please thank them for their service. To read more about our mission or the other Law Enforcement officers we 're defending, please visit **www.PoliceDefense.org**. And remember - Blue Lives Matter!_

name: ICYMI News
subject: Survey on the Department of Justice
body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from ICYMI News is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zphncrlf9c3sl83rj42ha2k75vprr23qdvsrmr3o_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cdhm4o36cth2bs) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it...
* Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights

* Hides the corruption of the ruling class

* Attacks those with traditional viewpoints

**That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zmu57rudqo05v0pum057i3kjho6rfq7c9phtn7to_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cdhm4o36cth2bs)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include:
* **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution

* **Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon

* **Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics

* **Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide

After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](http://e.icyminews.com/rd/9z2zadnli939o6dq9gm3mmldf17sofg4difukt1iqj0_rp22sh2s8i6eo35cdhm4o36cth2bs)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Arnn President, Hillsdale College Pursuing Truth and Defending Liberty Since 1844 |

name: Kristan Hawkins, Students for Life Action
subject: URGENT: Call your Representative today!
body:
Dear Pro-Life Friend,

I’m counting on your immediate action.

Joe Biden and his pro-abortion minions over at the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS) are attempting to strip life-saving Pregnancy Care Centers of funding.

And that’s why I need every pro-lifer reading this email to take action right away!

You see, the U.S. House is set to vote on _Students for Life Action’s_ bill, the _Supporting Pregnant and Parenting Women and Families Act_ (H.R. 6918), and your Representative needs to hear from you!

**_So, will you please contact your U.S. Representative right away at (202) 224-3121, and insist they do not cave to the Abortion Lobby’s demands_?**

And after you call your Representative, please forward this email to **EVERY** pro-lifer you know and ask them to take immediate action.

Pro-Life Friend, if the _Supporting Pregnant and Parenting Women and Families Act_ is voted down then Joe Biden and his pro-abortion pals at HHS will be one step closer to halting all funding for Pregnancy Care Centers.

It has never been more evident that the Biden Administration is not pro-woman, it’s just pro-abortion.

_And that’s why it’s critical you contact your Representative right away_.

The _Supporting Pregnant and Parenting Women and Families Act_ (H.R. 6918) sponsored by Rep. Fischbach (R-MN-7) would prohibit HHS Secretary, Xavier Becerra, and his pals in the Abortion Lobby from restricting funding for Pregnancy Care Centers.

Pro-Life Friend, these critically important centers offer more services than any abortion facility including Planned Parenthood, and virtually all for free. By giving women all their life-affirming options when faced with an unexpected pregnancy, they show kindness and compassion that can save lives and help women.

**So, please act right away by calling your U.S. Representative and urging them to vote YES on H.R. 6918 the _Supporting Pregnant and Parenting Women and Families Act._**

**[And after you’ve spoken with your Representative, would you please consider making a generous contribution to _Students for Life Action_ to help us continue our critical work](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sdtjhg-duchtdja-y/)?**

I think you’ll agree that there’s no better way to send a message to Planned Parenthood and its friends in the Biden Administration that pro-lifers will NOT be silenced than to have this bill passed ahead of this weekend’s National Pro-Life March and _National Pro-Life Summit!_

Please act right away.

Thousands of lives are in the balance.

For Life,

Kristan Hawkins
President, _Students for Life Action_

**[Donate to _Students for Life Action_ >>](https://studentsforlifeofamerica.cmail20.com/t/j-l-sdtjhg-duchtdja-j/)**

Students for Life Action is a non-profit, tax-exempt advocacy organization under section 501(c)(4) of the IRC. Contributions or gifts to Students for Life Action are not tax deductible for IRS purposes; they do, however, avoid recognition of gain on appreciated assets. Students for Life Action's mailing address is 600 Princess Anne St #7667, Fredericksburg, VA 22401. Any donations raised above or short of the goal will be used in the next area of greatest need towards our mission, as determined by the organization.

Friend,

There’s something you need to know: each and every time I’ve been underestimated, written off, or dismissed, I have proven my opponents wrong. We showed our strength at the Iowa caucuses and the nation knows now that there is an appetite for change in our Republican Party.

Our team has what it takes. We are in this to win for YOU. Not to schmooze the elites or appease the establishment.

I have never been the establishment's favorite, and I never will be, friend, but the people I serve have seen what a difference that can make in leadership, and I am ready to bring that to the White House.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f51fe2e9ffb63349e0eda096ddcbde4ff8a0a82e0248220b642141c8f965607ed5b05a1b12fd3a3220d82bee68377c8c4a0aad8e04775a714ec1a26a743edd27
HELP ME WIN THIS NOMINATION

I am counting on your support to show everyone that We The People will choose this election. It is your interests and needs that matter to me—no one else's.

We have no time to waste, and I need YOUR support the most. If you can, will you pitch in $20.24 today?

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f51fe2e9ffb63349cb59c2d96312a0e70fa45564fb8aca4c0427e5fedc0e9f689b10c93a4396ee4fba0649056c6f19a67ea7c1b29a458f92a1fd72bcb528ef4b

This road won't be an easy ride, but getting this country back on track for your future, our children, and the survival of this country is worth every day spent fighting.

Yours in Freedom,

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f51fe2e9ffb63349e0eda096ddcbde4ff8a0a82e0248220b642141c8f965607ed5b05a1b12fd3a3220d82bee68377c8c4a0aad8e04775a714ec1a26a743edd27

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f51fe2e9ffb63349e0eda096ddcbde4ff8a0a82e0248220b642141c8f965607ed5b05a1b12fd3a3220d82bee68377c8c4a0aad8e04775a714ec1a26a743edd27

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain.

After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom.

When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor.

Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide.

In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is personal and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

https://click.email.rondesantis.com/?qs=f51fe2e9ffb63349e0eda096ddcbde4ff8a0a82e0248220b642141c8f965607ed5b05a1b12fd3a3220d82bee68377c8c4a0aad8e04775a714ec1a26a743edd27

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has promised that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by immediately getting to work stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late.

In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and won every single time. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon.

That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now.

| January 19, 2024
Friend,
Last night, I was in Plymouth supporting my friend Kari MacRae, who is a Republican candidate for State Senate. Even though Plymouth is outside of my State Committee district, I am dedicated to supporting Republican candidates all across the Commonwealth who share our values.
[Support Kari's campaign. Click Here.](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016VoKdx1yDbiq-6V9JD0E4kiMt2CZbxrZQFGTBSDycAdqxo47zqQKn0z06WoapWwkQ_DHJPlBgNdbabEu6pEFrPKoaVE4cy0A6rwk5Nsit5UXClvD78IPJgdbYa-WrsaD_3ryivkf3mW_caUZFkR8nX15k4qVXsahLfKiQ-seNuEckN6HjdwJQTxZa6NTt-Imt7oO7qUop9IM6Z1RKRfeiw==&c=FNPUwkP0RFNyrJMMBbLK6tcYcu-8mDlewpOlprMAxQYJaK7GGdJRfw==&ch=aH_TA31_9UDbiI3yJ2sm2YfRi18JJ1EQ_CmJAVjfYU5ipTrRyStEyQ==)
Candidates like Kari are not career politicians, they are hardworking concerned citizens like you who decide to take a stand and put their lives on hold to run for public office, to fight for a better Massachusetts. These candidates not only deserve our support, they need our support.
KathyJo and I are tirelessly dedicated to supporting Republican candidates, and in our roles in the Republican State Committee, we will always fight to ensure great candidates like Kari are receiving the resources and support they need.
If you are willing to support me and KathyJo's race for the State Committee, so we can continue to fight for our candidates, you can do so here: [https://secure.winred.com/diehl-boss-for-state-committee/donate-today](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=0016VoKdx1yDbiq-6V9JD0E4kiMt2CZbxrZQFGTBSDycAdqxo47zqQKnyB6AvGb0p6l_SdioT1MvOGoH3wmxIZOPOHp0CCVW3759sjFHuWP-RMM8SFe5oWJKko0TndCXkGhKqn9t8fMa0hGjXQ1IrTMoiFc4qh11sHyZzwbIp-Yy0ORBuQX3aR-suBpDE5uRLANTk4h-W5Yn0sOEw86LlwEOg==&c=FNPUwkP0RFNyrJMMBbLK6tcYcu-8mDlewpOlprMAxQYJaK7GGdJRfw==&ch=aH_TA31_9UDbiI3yJ2sm2YfRi18JJ1EQ_CmJAVjfYU5ipTrRyStEyQ==)
As always, thank you for your support.
Geoff Diehl

body:

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Fri. Jan. 19, 2024
Bob Lorinser for Congress
info@votedrbob.com
906.250.9774
STATEMENT
Rep. Bergman's vote to shut down the government is irresponsible and reckless
Lorinser issues statement on stop-gap vote
GWINN, Mich. — "Yesterday, Rep. Jack Bergman was the only representative in Michigan who irresponsibly voted to shut down the government.
"Bergman claims he won't vote for 'any federal spending' until Congress addresses the border crisis. However, it's evident that he and other GOP extremists aren’t interested in resolving the border crisis; they only want to use it as a campaign wedge issue. The grandstanding is an intellectually dishonest, feckless political stunt.
"If Rep. Bergman's obstruction had succeeded, a shutdown would have disrupted crucial services that Northern Michiganders and Yoopers depend on, and it would have had harmful effects on the economy.
"Jack Bergman is not working in the best interest of the American people, and he's ignoring the needs of Michigan's 1st District. Posing for photo ops on the border at the epicenter of a national tragedy is not a solution. These extreme House Republicans are using the border crisis as a political weapon. Like Donald Trump, Jack Bergman appears to want the government to fail just because Democrats are in control. It's shameful.
"The border is a humanitarian and national security crisis. Immediate action is needed. President Biden and the Senate are diligently working towards a bipartisan deal. Hopefully, it will reflect both compassion and security. Holding the government hostage is irresponsible.
“Bergman voting no on a stop-gap bill, attempting to shut down the government, and refusing to negotiate on immigration reform jeopardizes our national security and our democracy. This issue isn't about politics; it's about people's lives.
"If elected, I will not allow party politics to stand in the way of solving our nation's problems. Northern Michigan and the UP deserve better. They deserve a Congressman willing to cooperate, collaborate, and compromise.
"These partisan political stunts are dangerous, and Rep. Bergman is proving to be a colossal waste of taxpayer money."
# # #
Dr. Bob Lorinser (D, MI01) is a former diplomat and family doctor from Marquette running for Congress in Michigan's First District.

Friend, There’s something you need to know: each and every time I’ve been underestimated, written off, or dismissed, I have proven my opponents wrong. We showed our strength at the Iowa caucuses and the nation knows now that there is an appetite for change in our Republican Party. **Our team has what it takes. We are in this to win for YOU. Ron DeSantis

---
| | |
_**Get to Know Ron DeSantis**_

| | | [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38211%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=N6wYT6plmhxcJN814WIsRA&sysid=1)
---

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

---
| [](https://click.youramerica.news/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=653%7c38211%7c920805%7c0%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=N6wYT6plmhxcJN814WIsRA&sysid=1)
---

On Day One, Ron DeSantis has _promised_ that he will bring a RECKONING for what unelected bureaucrats like Anthony Fauci and DC elites have done to children. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

body:

Rep. Bergman's vote to shut down the government is irresponsible and reckless
Official Statement on Stop-Gap Vote
https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
MAKE A CONTRIBUTION [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/about-bob]
Friend,
Yesterday, Rep. Jack Bergman was the only representative in Michigan who irresponsibly voted to shut down the government.
Bergman claims he won't vote for 'any federal spending' until Congress addresses the border crisis. However, it's evident that he and other GOP extremists aren’t interested in resolving the border crisis; they only want to use it as a campaign wedge issue. The grandstanding is an intellectually dishonest, feckless political stunt.
The grandstanding is a reckless political stunt.
If Rep. Bergman's obstruction had succeeded, a shutdown would have disrupted crucial services that Northern Michiganders and Yoopers depend on, and it would have had harmful effects on the economy.
Jack Bergman is not working in the best interest of the American people, and he's ignoring the needs of Michigan's 1st District. Posing for photo ops on the border at the epicenter of a national tragedy is not a solution.
These extreme House Republicans are using the border crisis as a political weapon. Like Donald Trump, Jack Bergman appears to want the government to fail just because Democrats are in control. It's shameful.
The border is a humanitarian and national security crisis. Immediate action is needed. President Biden and the Senate are diligently working towards a bipartisan deal. Hopefully, it will reflect both compassion and security. Holding the government hostage is irresponsible.
Bergman voting no on a stop-gap bill, attempting to shut down the government, and refusing to negotiate on immigration reform jeopardizes our national security and our democracy. This issue isn't about politics; it's about people's lives.
If elected, I will not allow party politics to stand in the way of solving our nation's problems. Northern Michigan and the UP deserve better. They deserve a Congressman willing to cooperate, collaborate, and compromise.
These partisan political stunts are dangerous, and Rep. Bergman is proving to be a colossal waste of taxpayer money.
-Dr. Bob
Bob Lorinser
Candidate for US Congress
Northern Michigan, Upper Peninsula
Democrat, MI01

body:
The survey will only take a few moments of your time

This sponsored message from Freedom Nation Today is on behalf of Hillsdale College
[](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4cee67583ff74ce9863fdcd1ca41c293&_e=CC_kmTnBHeToaeQ0unc0ZAL6U8kjycdnN7QW6XOCQIXoIwYHQPLAJo542OCrM4Pqomq9EfqpP9c2dzdn2Hi9fk-iEZNskRape05hvxD3_1GoIsmJWDlvhZ-ayW7YhTu-yhmjBKcRikc19I6NHoXli87XFBj5bEi8irEhnAB-C8mRJ9dFbDkW-nVsimQROjG6xlTYrnocOnuvkVrAidiNiaMMJdpSkf0s7ro6NfdVoN7nU7w0tGEebCx0CJPRNxjErggEgKszL9QAKzbeqrjx0spAWtxm_pfvzJDSPOMX5TnCZALyfzO9rDDoKE0DtzD-PcVaTKAdcxB2Ggoq5T90rhJhL1IuYo_7RqusQRVN3WmVbAykv_6G94aYqnNf_yrwNAbfZEDTatXz6exx0aSg6w%3D%3D) Dear Friend, Before you move on to your next email--I would appreciate it if you would take a few moments to participate in Hillsdale College's **National Survey on the Department of Justice.** The survey will only take a few moments of your time, and its subject affects your liberty and the very survival of the rule of law in America. **The current administration 's weaponization of the Department of Justice is unprecedented in American history.** Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights
Hides the corruption of the ruling class
Attacks those with traditional viewpoints **That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice.** By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4cee67583ff74ce9863fdcd1ca41c293&_e=CC_kmTnBHeToaeQ0unc0ZAL6U8kjycdnN7QW6XOCQIXoIwYHQPLAJo542OCrM4Pqomq9EfqpP9c2dzdn2Hi9fk-iEZNskRape05hvxD3_1GoIsmJWDlvhZ-ayW7YhTu-yhmjBKcRikc19I6NHoXli87XFBj5bEi8irEhnAB-C8mRJ9dFbDkW-nVsimQROjG6xlTYrnocOnuvkVrAidiNiaMMJdpSkf0s7ro6NfdVoN6xctyup-IpZh0phOztU3RIReDyjg3Z0oOg1FB4egoEEbnBPrOIhS9azBI-QKKVnMy21iKdCpZuGQo-FPdUhf-mLLTM0X6K4Aja0ho-GdksY5GIJDjvKdVHx5V_xmXBd58uBwwTP8GdzWPU5zf367FhlkYXQRTPnEjYeU_mdFfsJw%3D%3D)** The **Declaration of Independence** argues that **the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights** and that **just government is founded on the consent of the governed.** Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. **You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat.** A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is **reaching** and **teaching** millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our **Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions.** These efforts include: **Teaching bright and principled students** --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, **classical liberal arts education, including** a required course on the Constitution
**Distributing _Imprimis_** , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon
**Producing and promoting free online courses** for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics
**Providing a classical K-12 curriculum** with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our **National Survey on the Department of Justice** and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to **reach** and **teach** millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. **This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty.** If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. You can easily do so after completing the attached **National Survey on the Department of Justice** , which you can access at this secure link: **[https://lp.hillsdale.edu/department-of-justice-survey/](https://links.freedomnationtoday.com/u/click?_t=959d0fa54cad47baa4213176314ae733&_m=4cee67583ff74ce9863fdcd1ca41c293&_e=CC_kmTnBHeToaeQ0unc0ZAL6U8kjycdnN7QW6XOCQIXoIwYHQPLAJo542OCrM4Pqomq9EfqpP9c2dzdn2Hi9fk-iEZNskRape05hvxD3_1GoIsmJWDlvhZ-ayW7YhTu-yhmjBKcRikc19I6NHoXli87XFBj5bEi8irEhnAB-C8mRJ9dFbDkW-nVsimQROjG6xlTYrnocOnuvkVrAidiNiaMMJdpSkf0s7ro6NfdVoN7KaoktFvw8khck914hycgH8flSFnOvFpqfmlVRXtO9BXfUyP_7c3GOSZbgUJFMMEt9pFe7hRBP9LLAI1N3n7sgJlVPb4o1QFQgbb89IjO07P46sB9aplAsA6yD7ixmGKFvBGXVcg9Z8doAwsqOqYZ82nHSyCKUnURaawXCBtWpvA%3D%3D)** Thank you for your time and attention. I look forward to receiving your completed survey, and I sincerely appreciate your support of Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty. Warm regards, Larry P. Instead of protecting your God-given constitutional rights, the administration uses the Department of Justice to attack its political opponents... ...as well as Christians, parents, and anyone who dares to stand up for our constitutional liberties. At the same time, with the help of the media it... Covers up a two-tiered justice system that violates your constitutional rights Hides the corruption of the ruling class Attacks those with traditional viewpoints That 's why I'm asking you to take the Hillsdale College National Survey on the Department of Justice. By completing this survey, you will help us more clearly understand the views of mainstream Americans like you on this critical issue. Your responses will help Hillsdale strengthen its nationwide educational outreach efforts on behalf of liberty--including the importance of the rule of law and checks and balances, which the American Founders saw as essential safeguards against corruption. Friend, you can complete the National Survey on the Department of Justice by using the link below: The Declaration of Independence argues that the purpose of just government is to secure our natural rights and that just government is founded on the consent of the governed. Yet today's ruling class regularly disregards the will of the American people, and our rights--to the freedoms of speech, assembly, and religion, to due process, to gun ownership, and more--are under constant attack. You and I know that liberty in America is under serious threat. But as I travel around the country, I tell the audiences I speak to how we are engaging in the fight against this threat. A vital part of our efforts in this fight--in which Hillsdale College is a leader--is reaching and teaching millions of citizens, with the TRUTH about America's great heritage of liberty. We are heavily invested in our educational outreach efforts through our Project to Defend Liberty Nationwide by Reaching and Teaching Millions. These efforts include: Teaching bright and principled students --on our campuses in Hillsdale, Michigan, and Washington, D.C.--who receive a rigorous, classical liberal arts education, including a required course on the Constitution Distributing Imprimis , America's leading digest of liberty, which is mailed to more than 6.4 million homes and businesses ten times per year; previous issues include "The Politicization of the Department of Justice" by Harmeet K. Dhillon Producing and promoting free online courses for any citizen who wishes to learn, on topics such as the Constitution, American history, and free market economics Providing a classical K-12 curriculum with a solid grounding in American history, constitutional government, and economics to schools that educate thousands of students nationwide After everything we've seen over the past few years, the need for Hillsdale's educational outreach efforts is undeniable. So please share your views by completing our National Survey on the Department of Justice and returning it to me as soon as possible. It will only take a few minutes of your time. Your completed survey will help us form the most effective strategy to reach and teach millions of Americans on behalf of liberty. As you might know, Hillsdale College is almost unique in American higher education in its refusal to accept EVEN ONE PENNY of government funding--not even indirectly in the form of federal or state student grants or loans. This independence frees the College from burdensome and corrupting government regulations. But it also means that our work depends entirely on the generous support of private citizens, like you, who understand the importance of education to liberty. If you agree that we are now seeing an unprecedented assault on the American way of life, I hope you will partner with Hillsdale College by making a generous tax-deductible gift today. Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He’s taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

Efforts Made to Take Biden off the Ballot in Illinois | | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/95f9928dca2f/conforti-for-congress-8394724?e=25f4fa3311)

| | |

| | | Dear Peter,

This week, objections were filed against Biden's Illinois petitions in efforts to remove him from the ballot!

One challenge asserts that by Biden having a WDC notary notarize his petitions he broke Illinois election law, which requires an Illinois licensed notary.

A second, more damaging objection uses Section 3 of the 14th Amendment and states that Biden has aided our enemies, making him ineligible to hold the office of President of the United States, let alone any office.

The implications of these objections are huge!

Democrat efforts to remove Trump from the ballot could rebound on them and cripple the Biden campaign. With Illinois being such a blue state, Biden has most likely been counting on these electoral votes. Not having them could be a punch in the gut to the campaign. Also, if successful, these efforts could have a ripple effect across conservative states.

At the very least, this will put pressure on the Supreme Court to make a fair and just decision in the Feb 8 hearing of the Trump removal case.

You won't hear about this in the mainstream media. [Click Here](https://conforti4congress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fd34b7284bf7f5e87a4e45e5&id=0dc54cec70&e=25f4fa3311) for a video that details the objection using the 14th Amendment.

We certainly live in interesting times!

Stay Safe! Stay Strong!

If you'd like to support Conforti for Congress, you can click the link below.

[](https://conforti4congress.us6.list-manage.com/track/click?u=7fd34b7284bf7f5e87a4e45e5&id=603c228e4a&e=25f4fa3311)

Your support is greatly appreciated.
---
| Thank you,

Niki Conforti
Candidate
Illinois 6th Congressional District

Republican Chairman Gordon Ackley
