# **ICYMI: OH-13 Newspapers Applaud Congresswoman Sykes’ Efforts On Behalf Of District**
## “I just want this government to work for people in this area.” – Rep. Sykes
---
| **Akron, OH –** In case you missed it, both the [Akron Beacon Journal](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=6bcf548ce4&e=7730fa895a) and the [Canton Repository](https://emiliasykesforcongress.us20.list-manage.com/track/click?u=83820386dcff6cbe03ccbaec8&id=ff356c166e&e=7730fa895a) published editorials praising Congresswoman Emilia Sykes work on behalf of her the 13th Congressional District constituents. **"**_An effective lawmaker finds ways to assist those they were elected to serve and to advocate for their community, even when gridlock makes it nearly impossible to get laws passed_.” writes the **Akron Beacon Journal and Canton Repository Editorial Boards**. "_Sykes has taken this approach with her to Washington as she begins the second year of her first two-year term representing Ohio’s 13th Congressional District._ " Both editorials highlight Sykes' advocacy for the region, citing the $100 million in federal dollars she’s brought to the district and her ongoing efforts to bring back more federal support. **“** _This potential influx of federal funding could be exactly what Akron needs to take advantage of its historical strengths to expand the local economy._ ” writes the **Akron Beacon Journal Editorial Board**. **“** _She... urge[d] future expansions to include the region, citing such benefits as connecting travelers with the Akron-Canton Airport and workers in Central Ohio's growing job market with Greater Akron's more affordable housing stock. There's no word yet whether her request will go anywhere, but at least someone is speaking up for the region._ ” writes the **Canton Repository Editorial Board**. Sykes herself characterizes her work as “pretty boring”, adding "I just want this government to work for people in this area." "_In these times of uncivil discourse and ineffective division in federal politics, we'll take boring any day._ ” writes the **Akron Beacon Journal and Canton Repository Editorial Boards**.

[ stdin# ][IMG]

Peter Willis,

Big Pharma companies like Pfizer and Sanofi recently announced plans to
jack up the prices of over 500 prescription drugs. The most ridiculous
part: these corporations are raising prices in direct retaliation to
Medicare negotiating lower prices on just 10 medications.

Big Pharma is predictably punching back so they keep raking in tens of
billions a year by overcharging us for life-saving medications.

That’s why anything short of Medicare for All won’t work. Health insurance
companies, Big Pharma, and hospital conglomerates will find ways to profit
unless Bernie’s universal, guaranteed, free at the point of service M4A
legislation is enacted.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/13584?source=email-20240119&t=1011&akid=5214%2E5885482%2EVZEPpZ ]Add your name: Support Bernie’s Medicare for All bill in 2024. We must
keep building the groundswell for guaranteed health care for everyone. We
can’t let big corporations continue to profit while people suffer.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/13584?source=email-20240119&t=1012&akid=5214%2E5885482%2EVZEPpZ ]ADD YOUR NAME

Healthcare in America should be about health, not massive corporate
profits. Not only are we being ripped off, with millions bankrupted, but
people’s lives are being put at risk for pharma execs to buy another
yacht. It’s sick.

Healthcare is a human right, not something that should be denied to people
without the money to afford medication, a doctor visit, surgery,
chemotherapy, mental health treatment, or any other kind of care.

It was a big deal that our movement successfully pushed Congress to crack
the door open on drug price negotiation, but it wasn’t enough.

Recently on Capitol Hill, Rep. Ro Khanna directly called out Johnson &
Johnson for charging $160,000 per year for a Leukemia drug while it sues
the government over Medicare negotiating lower prices on just 10 drugs.
The gross profits of Johnson & Johnson in 2023 was $65 billion — and
corporate execs are still pulling out all the stops to protect their blood

Ron DeSantis comes from blue-collar roots in the state of Florida. Nothing was handed to him, he worked his way through college and led his team as the Yale Baseball captain. After earning his undergraduate degree, Ron DeSantis graduated from Harvard Law School, but was so moved by the events of September 11, 2001, that he volunteered to serve in the Navy to fight for our freedom. When he returned, he started a life of public service by serving Florida as both Congressman and now Governor. Despite all his years of fighting to ensure the American people enjoy the freedom we're promised in this country, he's watched the Left strip away freedoms at every turn and impose radical agendas on children, families, and consumers nationwide. In 2009, Ron met the love of his life Casey in Florida, and he's now the proud father of 6, 5, and 3-year-old children. Because of his kids, Ron DeSantis knows that this fight is _personal_ and understands the frustration parents face when teachers' unions and liberal groups shove a political agenda down the throats of children.

Ron DeSantis will ignite our Great American Comeback by _immediately getting to work_ stopping the invasion across our southern border, ensuring our military once again puts the mission first, declaring our economic independence, and restoring our American energy dominance so that our country gets back on track before it's too late. In Florida, Ron DeSantis' record speaks for itself. He's taken on the political establishment, politicized bureaucratic agencies, woke corporations, and the legacy media countless times and **_won every single time_**. Under his leadership, Florida has cultivated a thriving economy. It has stood as a citadel of freedom, and with him as our next President, America can once again be that shining City on a Hill for the rest of the world to look upon. _That's why he's running for President of the United States. Ron DeSantis knows that the decline of our country is a choice that cannot continue for another four years; the time to lead is now.... the time to act is now._

## Congress Passes Stopgap Funding Bill
Congress passed another short-term stopgap funding bill to keep the government open but [set new deadlines ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx80LFutDAQBOCnMR1odzE-KFz8jbv725TIh9fHRj6MwAfJ20fkAVLPSPNpPu7j3UuS5fnfv9iWmEc_FTl4THJwlK8Raxxq0qOugo3MxG3FFm_QmX4Aomq24CNO3QMDAHT6Rtixx9YMLWgTtdaVWALSgDhgjwP1jY46PsAENl0fqY1KAwcpeWs-syxl5pi-88FbM-VXlexcyrqr9p8ip8id59msOUmRKV8FRe6y1u81-MK7InetKXKAihz2ityUl-fG-5Xt87uEfC61P3grHGoAbI0mqjYb1lNSkt3clIbny0v6BZQ_b_kJAAD__1AaZN0)of March 1 and 8 for passage of a full budget. The Senate [passed its bill](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx80LFu6yAUgOGngY0IjjExA8NdvOWuHS0azjGnwmDFJG7fvmofoPMv_cP3dltukQvX9X_cMHRqS7x3fuFS-IXEn4tRxiuwi5UpECLgIDGYqx7d5DWAzIHi5NDDAON9sN7ClcjEcXA4OY2EUXIADVYb481kPEwXS5betUvoxolgIGE1Ju7tcfloXHtGKl_thY_LvW2yhNz7fojhn4BZwNwzZi7lpwmYc9uw4nkImK01TluvDqyxozp629e4K3rWxHVVR3721M6qEsZUuKKAWT5C2k8uhQ93FVavW-Tfs-x_WnwHAAD__375ZJQ) in the afternoon, 77-18, as lawmakers worked quickly to avoid the shutdown deadline of midnight tonight as well as a winter storm headed for Washington D.C. In the House, efforts by some representatives to [add an amendment ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLFuwyAURb8GNkfwjB08MHTxlq4dLRse4VUYIiB2-_dV8gHdrnSHo3O-bsttpUjp_rnuaJrPy2obHbhEOtDTzyI7OXWgFsWd8YiAPUcjr2IY9SQAeDB6E0JsYL20Crzs9QA9bE5Y5azXGjkZEKCElJPUcgJ9UV75TYwOx0F76D1TAh21XC7fmVIL6ONvPrBcbN55NKG1R2X9B4OZwdwCBorx9TGYQ94x4Vnf81mRwayUHCUMnc2pYjnWl07ttlwclm7dMbkdU-tqeDaXz8Rg5sW4x0kxUh2vTIn7vtIbwNu_Sf4CAAD__2rAZ1Y)on immigration to the bill were defeated, and the House voted under expedited rules for the stopgap funding bill. It passed 314-108 with mostly Democratic support.
## No Labels Says it's Targeted by 'Conspiracy'
No Labels, the nonprofit group trying to build support for a third-party presidential ticket, filed a complaint with the Justice Department alleging a ["conspiracy" ](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx80D2SozAQxfHTiEwu1IgPBQSbkHnTDSkhtaBtIVGoF49vP-U5wMS_4L36_7vPd0uR0vrX7jhyyLN1TBfOkS4M9DUrqYwEPevKjwERsKlwVH3ddoOpAaptDItxyofGd9r1ajEAenC-N40eBtsGrGiEGnStlFGDMjDcdNBhqTuPXTsEaILQNXrifN4emRJvGOI7X3jeXN6rOG7MRxHNHwGTgIk33CjGjwmYtrxjwlcRMDm7H5bWJGDSWrW9UTJlGe2CsUhbnkU-_hcmh9LjYU_eMbHkLCldWJhWyyhdTuWg07r3R5aY3VMuNsbMEkPIJ3-GqnP0x4tipNL1QtfrbunnT8W_FvwOAAD__4pIeR0)among mostly Democratic-aligned groups to block its work at every level. American Bridge, a Democratic Party opposition research organization, is openly focused on [thwarting outsiders](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx8kLFugzAURb_GbEb2s2NgYOjClq4dkYmfw6scjOyX0Px9RT-g05XOXY7O13W-ekq03T_9A0eOefY3phfOiV4Y6WfWUg8S7GybMEZEQNPgqDt1cf2gAJp19M504AGNCc5aDQbcxak4dNa4xcSloREUWKX1oHs9QN_aaOOiXEB36SOYKKzCQJxL-51p4xVjeucXlvaWH00aV-a9CvMhYBIwHcfRFnwylnr-J8klBQHTswqYFgq4SZ8SYZV7yix5PXw5h0qQuy_8lguFKnn1Jy3oGTe5UpUFMeGNKW_yNJZKS90LmJoyhv2glKi6Tlh1f3hKf3L8b7LfAAAA__9_Y3Fq) with legal challenges, whether _No Labels_ or Robert F. Kennedy Jr.'s independent effort. The effort is separate from, but dovetails with, Democrats' legal attempts to keep Donald Trump, a Republican, off primary ballots. Those cases are headed for the Supreme Court, while No Labels is now on the ballot in 14 states.
## List: States Ranked by Cost of Groceries
The average American family spends [roughly $270](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJx80LFuxCAQBNCvwR0nWGPOLlykcXdpU1oEFnsjDBZsLrm_jy5VqrQz0tNo3m7rzVGivL26A2eOZXWe6Y5rojtG-l611JMEs5ouzBERsO9w1lc12HFSAN0-a21ViB7Q2qEf3OSDsXrqw-DjdeqV62gGBUZpPelRTzBeTDTxXdmAdhgj9FEYhYG41MtHocw7xvQod6wXX44uzTvz2UT_ImARsPCOO6X07AQsfnd5o7xJd2Al7wQsFduJngUs5xPhh4DFGDUq08vGn-EhI-XQJO_YUDZ2jE22E3N4RvIojWXJcqvFYyVskvIfvatzOL8oJWr2KozaDke_Yzr-976fAAAA__9t6HbI) at the grocery store every week, but the total varies depending on where you live. New research shows the cheapest states to buy groceries are all in the Midwest. The new study, created by HelpAdvisor using U.S. census data, ranks all 50 states by how much groceries cost. The most expensive state is California, averaging $297 a week. But the most expensive city for groceries is Miami, at $327 a week. States spending the least on groceries are Wisconsin ($221), Iowa ($227), and Nebraska ($235). Will you step up to help me and House Republicans end the Biden Border Crisis today? My promise to you is that I’ll do everything in my power to ensure that Democrats respect the rule of law and fight to ensure that our border is strong. Sincerely, Speaker Mike Johnson | | | | Paid for by Mike Johnson for Louisiana |

clean_body: Pennsylvania is as competitive as can be. Hi Peter, it's Jon Favreau. I wouldn't exactly say I'm calm about 2024. Mitch McConnell is trying to take back the Senate, and if he does, Republicans will cut Social Security and Medicare, pack the courts with extreme right-wing judges, and make it harder to vote. The only way we can stop them is by protecting Democratic incumbents like Bob Casey who aren't afraid to stand up to Republican extremism. Let's not forget that in 2016, Donald Trump won the state by just over 40,000 votes. Yes, PA has had some big victories since then, but it's also seen razor-thin margins in swing counties and a fight to turn out voters in Democratic hubs like Philadelphia. Pennsylvania is as competitive as it gets, and with the Senate majority and the White House depending on it, we can't take anything for granted. If we're going to protect our Democratic Senate majority, our coalition to re-elect Bob Casey in 2024 has to be even bigger and better than PA saw in 2020 and 2022. It won't be easy, but it's what we have to do to win, and I know it's possible. Please use the links in this email to start a monthly donation through ActBlue. Thanks, Jon Jon Favreau Co-host of Pod Save America Former Speechwriter to President Obama

| More about Russell Prescott: A New Hampshire native of the Seacoast, Russell Prescott grew up in Exeter and currently lives in Kingston. For several decades, he was the co-owner and vice-president of R.E. Prescott Company, a wholesale distributor and manufacturer of water treatment systems. He purchased the business in 2020 and is now the president and sole owner.
Russell practiced Professional Engineering for 30 years and designs many of the products his company manufactures. As a result, he holds several patents for removing arsenic and radon from water. The company, founded in 1954 by his father, employs approximately 50 people and has operated in the same Exeter building since 1963.
Wanting to give back to his community, Prescott served five terms as a New Hampshire State Senator, being first elected in 2000 for two terms. He was re-elected in 2010, 2012, and again in 2014. As Senator, he represented Senate Districts 19 and 23, including towns from Newmarket to Plaistow and Derry to Seabrook.
Prescott was then twice elected to the Executive Council, once in 2016 and again in 2018. He decided to retire from the Executive Council in 2021 after purchasing his company.
Russell enjoys home restoration and recently finished a restoration of a 1737 colonial barn and grist mill in his town. His community service included Exeter Rotary Club, Kingston Lions Club, and the board of directors for the Exeter Area Chamber of Commerce.
He and his wife, Susan, have been married for 41 years, and they have five grown children and seven grandchildren. Following in their grandfather's and father's footsteps, his oldest three children are heavily involved with the daily operation and vision of the family business.

| | | **Uphold Our Fundamental Right on National Religious Freedom Day**
---

Dear Peter,
This week, we observed and honored National Religious Freedom Day. We are reminded of a core principle upon which our nation was founded: the freedom to believe and worship as we choose. In Washington's 8th Congressional district, we celebrate this fundamental right, recognizing its vital role in the tapestry of our diverse community.

However, the safeguarding of religious freedom requires more than acknowledgment; it demands active protection and advocacy. We’ve seen an attack on different religious beliefs recently. In Congress, I will fight to protect your ability to practice your religion and ensure that you can do it in a safe place.

In honor of National Religious Freedom Day, we invite you to join us in this commitment by contributing $20, $50, or even $100?

---
| | | |
---
|
Your contribution will enable us to:

* Promote legislation that reinforces our right to religious freedom.
* Foster interfaith dialogue and understanding within our community.
* Combat discrimination and intolerance in all its forms.

Friend, it’s Wendy Davis. Where do I even start?
As we speak, the anti-choice laws engineered by Texas Republicans like Ken Paxton, Greg Abbott, and Dan Patrick and supported by Ted Cruz are forcing women to flee our state to receive needed and emergency health care.
Nobody deserves the trauma or the unbearable emotional and physical stress that Texas’ abortion ban has wrought.
I’m outraged by what extremists in our government are putting women through. They are not reflective of who we are – and that’s why it’s essential that we elect leaders like my friend, Colin Allred, who will defend women’s reproductive rights. Can you split a donation between Colin and Serve America right now to help send Colin to the U.S. Senate? [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]
Friend, decisions around reproductive care are deeply personal and painful. But right now, our failed leaders are endangering pregnant women’s health in order to push their extremist agendas and further their political careers.
We deserve better, and that starts with defeating anti-abortion extremists like Ted Cruz and electing leaders – like Colin – with a record of standing up for the dignity and rights of Texas women.
We can’t wait any longer to take action, so please: Can you split a gift between Colin and Serve America right now to help Colin defeat Ted Cruz? Together, we can ensure that Texas women are treated with the dignity and respect that we deserve. [http://secure.actblue.com/donate/serve-allred]

I'm emailing to respectfully ask if you can [**chip in a donation of $3**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77374530/450238187/-1710610234?refcode=em-1.19.24-all-c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWQ1ZDVmNDQtMDNiNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzN2RhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8ufnBhEI0SfO7sD-vUfP6AGnilmpZINjMMXNXzs3q6E=) to my grassroots campaign to succeed Adam Schiff in CA-30.

Let me explain why:

We are less than 50 days away from one of this cycle’s most competitive congressional primary races.

And it's no secret that campaigns can be expensive – especially if you're running for Congress in the Los Angeles media market, the second priciest in the country.

It's not uncommon to see Democratic candidates resort to taking big checks from corporate PACs to keep up. **But I'm doing things a bit differently.**

We’re not talking corporate PAC cash and are counting on support from individual donors to power our efforts. And from early polling, we know our campaign has the most momentum with the people of CA-30.

But with so many voters just starting to tune into this race, the outcome is still very much undecided. And we have to ensure we can reach every voter across every inch of our district for the next seven weeks.

[**We’ve set a goal of 1,000 individual donors before the end of the month to show our grassroots strength and make sure we have the resources to contact every undecided voter. If you can, please chip in $3 today.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77374531/450238188/-1710610234?refcode=em-1.19.24-all-c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWQ1ZDVmNDQtMDNiNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzN2RhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8ufnBhEI0SfO7sD-vUfP6AGnilmpZINjMMXNXzs3q6E=)
| ****[Donate](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77374532/450238189/-1710610234?refcode=em-1.19.24-all-c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWQ1ZDVmNDQtMDNiNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzN2RhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8ufnBhEI0SfO7sD-vUfP6AGnilmpZINjMMXNXzs3q6E=)****

If you care about stopping the influence of big money in politics, then it’s crucial you support candidates who refuse to be funded by special interests. I accept no corporate PAC money because those are the values I’ll bring to Washington. Now, my campaign needs your help to make up for the major PAC money that has started to flood into this race.

[**Your support gives us the resources to reach voters and get over the finish line. Please chip in $3, or whatever you can, to help us ramp up our communication efforts with undecided voters and give CA-30 the unbought representative it deserves.**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77374533/450238190/-1710610234?refcode=em-1.19.24-all-c&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDM1MzYiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiYWQ1ZDVmNDQtMDNiNy1lZTExLWJlYTEtMDAyMjQ4MjIzN2RhIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=8ufnBhEI0SfO7sD-vUfP6AGnilmpZINjMMXNXzs3q6E=)

name: Beto O'Rourke
subject: The best way I can think of to honor Uvalde
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY POWERED BY PEOPLE
body:
[1]Powered By People

My heart is with the Uvalde families right now, who yesterday relived the
worst day of their lives as the Department of Justice released its
incident report on the Robb Elementary shooting.

Adding few details to those we had before, the report mostly confirmed
what we already knew — that the inaction of those in positions of public
trust failed the 19 children and two teachers who were murdered that day.

In addition to the hundreds of law enforcement officers who waited over an
hour to enter the classroom, Department of Public Safety Director Steve
McCraw has yet to be held accountable for the failed response and
subsequent cover-up.

Governor Abbott and our Republican-led legislature made it far too easy
for a troubled 18-year-old to purchase two AR-15s and over 1,600 rounds of
ammunition. These are the same failed leaders who, after Midland-Odessa,
Sutherland Springs, Santa Fe, and El Paso, did nothing but make it more
likely that Uvalde would happen.

But in the face of this inaction and failed leadership, we have the heroes
that we need in this moment. Every day for the past 20 months, the Uvalde
families have been doing all in their power to stop the next mass
shooting.

Their advocacy has brought us closer than ever to raising the age to
purchase an assault weapon, convincing several Republican legislators to
buck their party to help us move on this. They pushed a divided Congress
to pass the Bipartisan Safer Communities Act, which represents the first
major federal gun safety measure passed in nearly 30 years.

They’re putting in the work, they’re struggling through the pain, and
they’re doing it all knowing that even though they can’t bring back their
children, their effort, courage, and persistence may be able to save ours.

I hope you will join me in following their lead and demanding
accountability for those who have made Texas a deadly place to be a kid.

If you live in Texas, that means joining us in registering your neighbors
to vote. With over 3 million eligible but unregistered Democrats in our
state, we need your help to bring these Texans off of the sidelines and
into the fight to replace the politicians who are failing us right now.

Sign up for a training on how to help register voters:

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60943?_gl=1%2Awtvpx6%2A_gcl_au%2AMTQxNjY4NzIwNi4xNzAyODQ3MzAx%3Fsource%3Dema20240119-238133&t=1001&akid=238133%2E444211%2ECXGsHj ]Sunday, Jan. 21 at 1PM
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60944?_gl=1%2Awtvpx6%2A_gcl_au%2AMTQxNjY4NzIwNi4xNzAyODQ3MzAx%3Fsource%3Dema20240119-238133&t=1002&akid=238133%2E444211%2ECXGsHj ]Tuesday, Jan. 23 at 6PM
[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/60945?_gl=1%2A1nrrh34%2A_gcl_au%2AMTQxNjY4NzIwNi4xNzAyODQ3MzAx%3Fsource%3Dema20240119-238133&t=1003&akid=238133%2E444211%2ECXGsHj ]Thursday, Jan. 25 at 12PM

[ https://act.betoorourke.com/go/56109?c0=pbp-em-20240119.jIaVhJ&refcode=ema20240119-238133&t=1004&akid=238133%2E444211%2ECXGsHj ]Otherwise, I hope you can support our work with a donation today to
help us register more voters and put in the work to ensure they turn out
in these elections.

If enough people join us in this effort, we’ll have a real shot at
electing leaders who will listen to the Uvalde families and the vast
majority of Texans who want to see common sense gun laws in this state.

This is the best way I can think of to honor Uvalde.

Beto

**Now, 13% means third place, and that means Katie is OUT of the race to be California’s US Senator.**

The prevailing narrative emerging from Iowa was that Donald Trump has an iron-fisted grip on the Republican Party, that he's destined to be the 2024 nominee, and that Americans will get the inevitable rematch between Trump and Joe Biden they say they do not want. I have a three word reaction:
**Not so fast.**
You see, I'm a proud Granite State voter and have spent significant time with most of the GOP presidential candidates. Heck, most have been in my living room to make their pitch to family, friends, neighbors, and colleagues. One thing I've picked up from these interactions is crystal clear: There is a strong appetite for change, a desire to move forward rather than looking in the rear-view mirror, and an increasing urgency to this effort.
New Hampshire is a fiercely independent state. We think for ourselves. We don't follow public opinion and we're definitely not going to do something because the hearty folks in Iowa made a statement.
There's a familiar old joke about the New Hampshire voter who is asked if they're going to vote for a particular presidential hopeful. The punch line is "I don't know yet, I've only met the candidate four times."
In other words, in New Hampshire, we take retail politics very seriously. And by that I don't mean campaign events in shopping destinations. We also listen to anyone who expresses interest in seeking the office. Don't believe me? [Take a peek at the sample ballots on the New Hampshire Secretary of State's website](https://substack.com/redirect/e1bbde4a-50ba-41f4-8549-ee42e81ebf9d?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg). The citizens of the Granite State view our evaluation of presidential candidates as a solemn responsibility to the nation. And we do so on both sides of the aisle.
_**New Hampshire is a fiercely independent state. We think for ourselves. We don 't follow public opinion and we're definitely not going to do something because the hearty folks in Iowa made a statement.**_
The culmination of this effort is the first-in-the-nation presidential primary which takes place next Tuesday, Jan. 23. While polls have long had former President Donald Trump leading the pack, the field has narrowed considerably. This means that the dynamics of the New Hampshire primary are not certain or set. At this point, it appears to be a two-person race between Trump and former South Carolina governor and U.N. Ambassador Nikki Haley. And don't dismiss the 2024 Democratic New Hampshire primary; it's still going on, even if President Biden isn't on the ballot.
The single most important question that will impact the outcome of the primary is "Will independents show up?" A follow-up question would be "Which primary will they choose to vote in"?
Partisan identification in New Hampshire is roughly 30% Democrat, 30% registered Republican, and 40% independent (or as we refer to them here, "undeclared"). This matters because undeclared candidates can vote in a Republican primary. Given Trump's popularity with the Republican base, Haley's path likely runs through voters who are undeclared.
Given expectations, even a slim Haley victory would be a significant development. Also, a poor showing for Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis, which the polls suggest is all but inevitable, obviously won't help his campaign. And if it is a Trump win, the question will be: "By how much?"
All of this will affect the field of competitors going forward. Another question will be about the Democratic Party primary and how Biden's write-in campaign fares. A strong showing by the only serious Democratic challenger, Minnesota congressman Dean Philips, might alter the national narrative - and the Democrats' commitment to the incumbent president. These questions matter because the outcome of the New Hampshire race has the potential to change the outcome of the November election and the future of the United States.
To say that Granite Staters punch above their weight is an understatement. Nevada's tourist industry is fond of its puckish mantra "What happens in Vegas, stays in Vegas." Well, here in New Hampshire, we're confident that what happens in the Granite State does not stay within our borders and has a positive impact on the rest of the country.
_**Vikram Mansharamani, a 2022 candidate for the U.S. Senate, lives in Lincoln, New Hampshire. He is the author of "[The Making of a Generalist: An Independent Thinker Finds Unconventional Success in an Uncertain World.](https://substack.com/redirect/e3bdd566-54e7-4a16-b864-a4e2a973257c?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)"**_

| Peter,

In 2016, after three years of horrific wildfires and watching millions of acres of forests die and burn, I ran for Commissioner of Public Lands because I was determined to do my part _to keep Washington State – the Evergreen state – evergreen._

Within my first year, I launched the Keep Washington Evergreen Initiative **to restore one million acres of forest** to health and conserve one million acres of forest from development. In just six years, we have made significant progress, _restoring over 600,000 acres of forestlands, preventing hundreds of thousands of acres from burning, and conserving another almost 200,000 acres from development._

The challenges our forests, waters, and communities are facing go beyond Washington state. Year after year, climate change is having a horrific destructive impact on every corner of our country, from increasing wildfires and dying forests to drought, deadly heat waves, and flooding.

Now, with an eye toward a brighter, more sustainable future for every American,**I am taking my bold vision and my relentless commitment to climate action to Congress.** Because the challenges our environment and our communities face deserve nothing shy of EPIC goals and EPIC progress.

I can’t do this without you, however. I need your support to ensure my vision reaches every voter in Washington’s 6th Congressional District. clean_body: I need your support to ensure my vision reaches every voter in Washington’s 6th Congressional District. | = | Peter, In 2016, after three years of horrific wildfires and watching millions of acres of forests die and burn, I ran for Commissioner of Public Lands because I was determined to do my part to keep Washington State – the Evergreen state – evergreen. Within my first year, I launched the Keep Washington Evergreen Initiative to restore one million acres of forest to health and conserve one million acres of forest from development. In just six years, we have made significant progress, restoring over 600,000 acres of forestlands, preventing hundreds of thousands of acres from burning, and conserving another almost 200,000 acres from development. The challenges our forests, waters, and communities are facing go beyond Washington state. Year after year, climate change is having a horrific destructive impact on every corner of our country, from increasing wildfires and dying forests to drought, deadly heat waves, and flooding. Now, with an eye toward a brighter, more sustainable future for every American,I am taking my bold vision and my relentless commitment to climate action to Congress. Because the challenges our environment and our communities face deserve nothing shy of EPIC goals and EPIC progress. I can’t do this without you, however. subject: In seven days, Trump is coming back to Arizona.
disclaimer_text: Paid For By Gallego for Arizona
body:
He’s coming because he knows Arizona is critical to his re-election.
#

Peter:
In one week, Donald Trump is coming back to Arizona. He’s coming because he knows Arizona is critical to his re-election.
But put that aside for a minute. Today, we want you to think back a few years.
Think about how it felt back in 2020 when we kicked Trump out of the White House. When we sent people like Mark Kelly and Rev. Warnock to the Senate.
It felt good, didn’t it?
And when we won again in Arizona and Georgia in 2022, when we held the Senate — that felt like progress.
Good things happened because lots of good people took action in those campaigns. We passed bipartisan gun safety laws and protections for voting rights, we capped the cost of insulin and made huge investments in infrastructure and renewable energy.
But if Kari Lake wins... if Mitch McConnell becomes Majority Leader... if Trump is President. That isn’t just bad. It’s dangerous. It could be the end of our democracy itself.
That’s why we need you with us. And that’s why we are asking:

Friend,
---
Democrats in Wisconsin are going to great lengths to obstruct our election security efforts.
---
A left-wing judge with longtime ties to liberal Governor Tony Evers made a ruling earlier this month _**ALLOWING**_ ballot curing statewide for this year’s election.
---
Ballot curing is the process of “correcting” ballots containing incorrect information about the voter. The process allows election clerks to subjectively address ballot discrepancies such as missing signatures and wrong addresses.
---
It even enables clerks to correct the vote cast on a given ballot.
---
It’s a vehicle for voter fraud and will only further diminish the already eroding public trust in America’s election system.
---
We need to restore the public’s confidence in our elections. That’s why I introduced the most conservative election integrity legislation in 20 years, the American Confidence in Elections Act.
---
Some key voter integrity provisions in my bill include:
---
* Voter ID laws
* Greater election observer access
* Stops non-citizens from voting
* Annual voter list maintenance
* Ends unsolicited mailing of ballots to outdated lists

---
**I’m not going to back down now** as Democrats work to obstruct our election security efforts.

clean_body: It’s an uphill battle from now until November... | Friend, Democrats in Wisconsin are going to great lengths to obstruct our election security efforts. A left-wing judge with longtime ties to liberal Governor Tony Evers made a ruling earlier this month ALLOWING ballot curing statewide for this year’s election. Ballot curing is the process of “correcting” ballots containing incorrect information about the voter. The process allows election clerks to subjectively address ballot discrepancies such as missing signatures and wrong addresses. It even enables clerks to correct the vote cast on a given ballot. It’s a vehicle for voter fraud and will only further diminish the already eroding public trust in America’s election system. We need to restore the public’s confidence in our elections. That’s why I introduced the most conservative election integrity legislation in 20 years, the American Confidence in Elections Act. Some key voter integrity provisions in my bill include: Voter ID laws Greater election observer access Stops non-citizens from voting Annual voter list maintenance Ends unsolicited mailing of ballots to outdated lists I’m not going to back down now as Democrats work to obstruct our election security efforts. Friend, we need to do everything in our power to restore transparency and public trust in our elections. ---
| During a recent call with a potential donor, I was asked why I was qualified to run for Congress. As I answered him with just three words, I realized what makes me a great candidate for Congress is the same reason I was able to achieve a major goal a few months ago.

Last year, Sarah and I marked a HUGE accomplishment off our bucket lists. **We hiked to Everest Base Camp** – the spot in the Himalayas where climbers begin their ascent of Mount Everest, the tallest mountain in the world.

Our trek spanned more than 90 miles and reached nearly 20,000 feet. We fought to cling to cables as we pulled ourselves up an icy 55-degree slope and struggled for footing as we scrambled across the largest glacier in Nepal.

Our lungs ached as each breath contained only half as much oxygen as one in Las Vegas.

_It was so cold at night that our toothpaste froze in the tube_ , and we slept with our water bottles in our sleeping bags to prevent the water from turning into blocks of ice.

Only 60% of the people in our party completed the trek. The rest had to be evacuated by helicopter.
---
|
---
|
---
| _But we made it._

Why? _**Because we were prepared.**_

Sarah and I hiked hundreds of miles to ensure our legs and lungs could handle the trek. We relied on high-quality gear that we’d trusted for years. Our boots were broken in and comfortable.

We brought sleeping bags designed to keep us warm at -10 degrees, crampons to secure our steps on glaciers, and iodine tablets to purify unsafe water.

_We understood what was required of us to succeed._ As a result, we had an amazing adventure we’ll never forget – and we made it home safely with nothing worse than a few sore muscles and a rough case of jetlag!

So, when that potential donor asked why I thought I’d be a good member of Congress, I simply said, _**“Because I’m prepared.”**_
---
|
---
|

As the statewide voice for grassroots Illinois Democrats, one of our top priorities is understanding what voters like you care about. With Election Day 2024 inching closer and closer, we’re relying on your survey results to inform candidate strategy around the state.

We rely on up-to-date survey data from voters across the state, including urban, rural, and suburban types; everyone from corporate executives to small-town farmers; first-time voters, and those that have been voting for decades.

body:

============================================================
Dear Fellow Republicans,

Please see the following PSA from the Michigan Independent Citizens Redistricting Commission:

ICRC banner
MICRC SEEKS PUBLIC INPUT IN DETROIT
Lansing, Mich—The Michigan Independent Citizens Redistricting Commission seeks to hear from all Michigan residents, especially those impacted by the reconfiguration of the Michigan House of Representatives districts #1, 7, 8, 10, 11, 12, and 14, at its in-person meetings next week in Detroit.
The Commission will meet in-person at the following locations in the City of Detroit:
* Monday, January 22 from 10:00 a.m.-3:00 p.m. and 6:00-8:30 p.m. at Huntington Place (formerly known as Cobo Hall).
* Tuesday, January 23 from 10:00 a.m.-3:00 p.m. and 6:00-8:30 p.m. at Huntington Place (formerly known as Cobo Hall).
* Wednesday, January 24 from 10:00 a.m.-5:30 p.m. at Cadillac Place.
* Thursday, January 25 from 9:00 a.m.-5:30 p.m. at Cadillac Place.
* Friday, January 26 from 9:00 a.m.-5:30 p.m. at Cadillac Place.

Huntington Place is located at One Washington Boulevard. Cadillac Place is located at 3044 W. Grand Boulevard. The commission will take a lunch break between 12:00-1:00 p.m. each day.
“This new redistricting process places a premium on public input,” emphasized Commissioner Cynthia Orton, MICRC chairperson. “We strongly encourage the public to sign-up to provide live or remote public comments. In addition, the public can provide comments through our portals located at the Commission’s website or mail us a letter.
The public can sign-up to provide live, virtual, or written public comment at ** Public Comment Form (office.com) (https://lnks.gd/l/eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiJ9.eyJidWxsZXRpbl9saW5rX2lkIjoxMDAsInVyaSI6ImJwMjpjbGljayIsInVybCI6Imh0dHBzOi8vZm9ybXMub2ZmaWNlLmNvbS9wYWdlcy9yZXNwb25zZXBhZ2UuYXNweD9pZD1oM0Q3MVhjM3JVS1dhb2t1OUhJbDBZdktfTUtYZVJWSXI2ODVkU1NSR210VU56VTVOamRETmpCQ1YxVkVWMVJaTjAxT1JsQkhUMHBXUVM0dSIsImJ1bGxldGluX2lkIjoiMjAyNDAxMTkuODg3OTg1MDEifQ.qS7IFu0ulqSuoshJPW9Ogh2uXwOUl8rsFO-gHvl3gN8/s/1250912772/br/235642170040-l)

The ongoing erosion of the freedom to vote in the U.S. is a direct result of a decade of rulings by the federal courts that have whittled away the protections of the Voting Rights Act.
As anti-voter extremists continue waging a nationally coordinated effort to push ballot access as far out of reach as possible — particularly for Black and brown voters — the Protect the Vote Act could not come at a more urgent time.
This critical piece of legislation would make it easier to defend the freedom to vote by lowering a burdensome threshold imposed by the Supreme Court for those types of legal challenges. And it would help ensure all of our communities can participate in the democratic process.
**Let’s do everything we can to get this bill over the finish line. We need every Fair Fight Action member to add their voice to this fight. **

body:
Over the past few weeks, I’ve heard from hundreds of Michiganders

[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77379856/450255761/1433120897?refcode=email-header&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4YWY0Y2Q5YS0xMWI3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=IteweIgEolmg6FI1LGH4_gmKpg9wc2CSw_x-IZzg3g0=) Over the past few weeks, I’ve heard from hundreds of Michiganders about what they want for their future and their kids' future – about what the Michigan Dream means to them: A good job. A quality education. A home of their own. The right to make their own health care decisions. It is all common sense, and yet our dysfunctional Congress isn’t doing enough to help families get ahead. Instead, too many are too focused on Twitter followers and extremes. I’m running for Congress to change that. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77379884/450255901/1532741920?refcode=email_012124_Bio&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MGRiMjBjMS0xMWI3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5Ilu64AaD6ViO2_yJ3hpvb4BFoS4Z6-JAPO6K6aPMAg=) [_**I’m Kristen McDonald Rivet and I’m running for Congress in Michigan’s 8th District. I know this is a long email, but I hope you’ll read the whole thing, then chip in to help me win this toss-up race for Congress.**_](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77379885/450255902/1532741920?refcode=email_012124_Bio&amounts=5,15,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzMvMS85NjAyNCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI0MGRiMjBjMS0xMWI3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5Ilu64AaD6ViO2_yJ3hpvb4BFoS4Z6-JAPO6K6aPMAg=) I’m a proud mom of six (yes, six!) wonderful children, and I’ve spent my career fighting to make things just a little easier for hard-working Michigan families like mine. I grew up in Portland, Michigan. My dad worked construction, often clocking in 70 to 80 hours a week. When the construction season slowed down and it got cold, he worked snow removal to make ends meet. Like many people in this district, Dad wasn’t afraid to get calluses on his hands through a tough day’s work. Through grit and hard work, my family was able to achieve what I call the Michigan Dream: to own a home, pay the bills, put a little away for retirement, and, every once in a while, have the chance to drive to Disney World. Thanks to my mom and dad, my sisters and I were the first in our family to go to college, and I have been working to uplift families like ours ever since. I was elected to the Michigan State Senate, where I fight every day to support Michigan families and combat extremism. I led the charge to pass the largest tax cut for working families in Michigan’s history. I introduced a plan to address the growing childcare crisis in our state. I’ve fought to protect abortion rights for women, and, in one of my first acts in the State Senate, passed a commonsense gun violence prevention bill. Now, I’m running for Congress because the Michigan Dream is falling out of reach for too many families, and we need to pass solutions through the U.S. Congress that will help level the playing field. I will make sure we invest in our workers and create good-paying jobs right here in Michigan, protect abortion rights, and work to keep our kids safe from the epidemic of gun violence. He is accused of a laundry list of crimes including theft, fraud, official misconduct, and obstruction. He is alleged to have used funds intended for a nonprofit organization to pay child support. Noel’s apparent behavior is shameful and left the people of Clark County behind. But for some reason, Noel has been allowed to retain his position as a chair for the Republican Party. **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77380205/450257130/-657874286?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmFlY2RlMy0xM2I3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EvyCZuvryU-VHeR5DJHH8pbRE80x62PH1IpqFRaECEc=&emci=b402cf71-09b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=6baecde3-13b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=4925535)**[ Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77380206/450257131/-657874286?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmFlY2RlMy0xM2I3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EvyCZuvryU-VHeR5DJHH8pbRE80x62PH1IpqFRaECEc=&emci=b402cf71-09b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=6baecde3-13b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=4925535) If the state Republican Party wants to support law enforcement agents, repair trust in government, and show they truly care about law and order, they should finally do what they needed to long ago — remove Noel from his leadership position ****_Each week, the State Party will highlight key policy from Democrats at the Statehouse or across the state. Democrats deliver a better future for Hoosier families, and we urge you to share this information with your networks._ **[](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77380207/450257132/-711700592?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmFlY2RlMy0xM2I3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EvyCZuvryU-VHeR5DJHH8pbRE80x62PH1IpqFRaECEc=&emci=b402cf71-09b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=6baecde3-13b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=4925535)**[ Share INDems](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77380208/450257133/-711700592?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmFlY2RlMy0xM2I3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EvyCZuvryU-VHeR5DJHH8pbRE80x62PH1IpqFRaECEc=&emci=b402cf71-09b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=6baecde3-13b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=4925535) _Rep. Blake Johnson’s Bill to Increase Road Safety_ State Representative Blake Johnson is sponsoring a bipartisan bill aimed at preventing cyclist and pedestrian deaths. The bill would hold reckless motorists accountable in order to proactively prevent accidents. Last year, there were [47](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/77380209/450257134/-703351353?nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDMvMS82NzYzNSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI2YmFlY2RlMy0xM2I3LWVlMTEtYmVhMS0wMDIyNDgyMjM3ZGEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogIkRQV0lMTElTNjdAR01BSUwuQ09NIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=EvyCZuvryU-VHeR5DJHH8pbRE80x62PH1IpqFRaECEc=&emci=b402cf71-09b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&emdi=6baecde3-13b7-ee11-bea1-0022482237da&ceid=4925535#/dashboard) fatal accidents in Indianapolis involving pedestrians and cyclists. This number is unacceptable, and we are grateful to Representative Johnson for his leadership on this issue. His bill, House Bill 1281, [passed Fellow American,

I want to introduce myself.

My name is Nella Domenici – I’m a proud New Mexican, devoted mother, wife of a Navy veteran, businesswoman, and I’m excited to announce to you that **I am running to be the next Republican U.S. Senator from New Mexico.**

**It’s not breaking news for me to say our nation and state are clearly on the wrong track.**

To say that Joe Biden and my opponent Martin Heinrich’s policies have failed us seems inadequate – _it’s like they don’t even understand us._

**The cost of living is way up, the border is wide open, our crime and drug crises are out of control, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.**

Hardworking New Mexicans are suffering from these failures. We need new leadership in Washington who will improve, energize, and restore hope to our state and our country.

[**That’s why I’m running for Senate, and I’m asking for your support to help me restore fiscally conservative, commonsense, and impactful leadership both in New Mexico and the U.S. Senate by making a Week One donation to my campaign today.**](http://links.freedomfirstalert.com/u/click?_t=9ca143e971904d26a973d002cb0ae7f7&_m=be2a13e33d634146a6de7ab9d8289714&_e=k1FAdfJ-GL05akPe0aY8NxwPQ8Gpsq1bN_htL09ZSzo8_ZuMBrzjpa8u_43QoaQtZlKSQ-XAApO0HXmspg-uBw1X7x-e_jJWdFS1BLA13Y2vm_GOcXgEMIZmXh09g7dvs5VOsAy0YLSXHQHlTDQ8O4Y5gHFSOF7p9LX9EiKZ5ny8w48bES_-hMGmGone8u4czdno-uyVRPxWsqdY5_C5L_RwGZGnLsAdZfTzjGhkn0aSrym76aUtDWAbKNH681-R-VwNEJp2ia8rDZjLcPxqnHgmkN6O76f8KjCSJs33lylJekAyDLVXoxj8TjEo92JycZnKmr1DtfSLgYw6uTHvsSnxJwjeUbcRN4-wHVfSn9jrA3dWpGrJCa3W0Zt16VG7HFwAuJMQW2QHdw_aVGqgUA%3D%3D)

New Mexico is my home. **My family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and it is here that I have always returned.**

I understand the importance of hard work, like most New Mexicans. I waited tables to help pay for my undergraduate degree from Georgetown University. While holding down a full-time job, I paid my way through night school at Georgetown Law. I also paid for Harvard Business School, graduating as a Baker Scholar, top 5% of the class, while nine months pregnant.

I began my career at the bottom and worked my way up through the complex finance world, where I eventually served as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In my career, I have advised, invested in, grown, and led many companies, and served on public company boards. **Collectively, the companies I have been heavily involved with have employed thousands of Americans.**

I am uniquely prepared and qualified to fight for a significantly improved New Mexican economy. My professional experience and education enable me to deeply understand taxation, inflation, setting and managing huge budgets, and creating incentives and benefits that serve employees, and attract new businesses and entrepreneurs.

New Mexico is blessed with abundant natural resources, cultural diversity, rich traditions, hard-working people, and leading national laboratories and military installations. **But sadly, our leaders in Washington and Santa Fe have failed us.**

I will fight to secure our borders, bring costs down, ease financial burdens on New Mexico families struggling to get by, and ensure America is once again the land of opportunity and freedom.

**I’m in this fight to win – and with your support, we will get the job done to flip this seat and restore a Republican majority in the Senate!**

[**We can and must do better for New Mexico and America. _**Nella Domenici**_
Republican for Senate

| **ABOUT NELLA**
**“New Mexico is my home. I was born in Albuquerque and lived for most of my childhood in a home near the intersection of Lomas Blvd. and Monroe St. with my seven brothers, sisters, and parents - Pete and Nancy Domenici. I began my education at Our Lady of Fatima, where I learned the values I hold today. I am the devoted mother of two, step-mom of four, and the wife of a Navy Veteran. My family’s roots run deep in New Mexico and it is here that I have always returned, no matter where my life has taken me. My husband Pat and I cherish our home in New Mexico, that we have owned for nearly twenty years.

Like my father and mother, I have been a warrior for those who most need an advocate: for women competing in academics or business, for families dealing with mental illness, and for those whom quality healthcare was out of reach. I have also been a champion of improving the education of our youth in underserved communities.

Like everyone starting their career, I began at the bottom and worked my way up through the complex finance world, where I eventually served as CFO for one of the world’s largest, most successful investment firms. In my career, I helped build businesses, helped companies grow, and created jobs. With this business experience, I will help New Mexico attract new companies and create jobs - so hardworking New Mexicans can find success and live their American Dream.

New Mexico is blessed with abundant natural resources, cultural diversity and rich traditions, hardworking people, and leading national laboratories. But sadly, our leaders in Washington and Santa Fe have failed us. The cost of living is up, we are in a crime crisis, the border is wide open, and our public education system is leaving our kids behind.

We are clearly on the wrong track. We can and must do better. That’s why I am running for the United States Senate.” _-Nella_**

---
| [ ](https://binkley2024.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=5894b488eac5a196e1e5d6896&id=84859dd653&e=c1403f41d3)

# Binkley Brigade, We Want Your Help
Ryan's strong finish in Iowa caught many people and political pundits off-guard. We can see many people asking 'Who is Ryan Binkley?' Stephen Colbert asked this question this week on The Late Show. 'Election Twitter' is asking the question too. We want you to help give America an answer.

Here's how you can help:

We want you to make a social media post that starts with you saying, **"America is asking 'Who is Ryan Binkley? I want to answer."**

This post can be several different things:
* A 30 to 40-second long video. This is the preferred post we would like you to make, but if you are uncomfortable being on camera, you can also make a:

* 50 to 100-word post. This post can include an image if you want, so long as it relates to the Binkley campaign and is respectful. Recommended images are photos from Binkley events, merchandise, or pictures with Ryan himself.

* Preferred social media sites for this post are Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, Snapchat, and LinkedIn. For Facebook, make your post **public** so others can see it.

The social media post, whether it's a video or written message, should have three points:
* **"Ryan Binkley is... [how do you know him?]"** Consider the following:
\- My neighbor
\- My friend
\- My pastor
\- My favorite candidate

* **"I am enthusiastic for Ryan's leadership on [political issue important to you]." **Consider the following:
\- Economic growth
\- Inflation
\- Healthcare
\- Border control

* **"That's why I am supporting Ryan Binkley as the Republican nominee for President of the United States."**

Be ready to share your post on your social media**this Saturday, January 20 at 1 PM CT.** Let's flood the Internet with the answer to America's question 'Who is Ryan Binkley?'

### Best Practices for Video:
* Hold your phone camera at the height of your eyes and look at the camera, not the screen.

* Consider what's in the background while you are filming.

* Make sure you are reasonably well-lit (This does not have to be professional; it's great to feel like something real people are doing as a real response)

* Make sure the ratio of your camera matches the social media site you want to post this one. A good rule of thumb is to hold the camera vertically and center your head in the shot. That works for everything.

### Best Practices for Writing:
* Use active voice in your writing. 'Ryan serves as a CEO,' not 'The CEO is Ryan.'

* Hit the three points with clear and precise language. Don't waste words and get right to the point.

* Don't add any links to Ryan's social media or website. This is about sending a message from the heart.

Additionally, if for some reason 1 PM on Saturday is not a convenient time for you to make a post, do it at the next convenient time afterward.

Be sure to use the following hashtags:
#WhoIsRyanBinkley
#Binkley2024
#Believe2024
#Binkmentum
#FITN
#NHPolitics

One more thing. We would love for you to email your videos to us at reachus@binkley2024.com. Please include your first and last name, home city, state, and a sentence that says we have permission to reuse your videos to support Ryan as a candidate. **[You may reuse my video in whole or in part to support Ryan as a candidate].** Use the following subject line for your email: **Video: Who is Ryan Binkley**

Emailing the video is optional, but greatly appreciated.

Let's tell America who Ryan is!

God bless,

Binkley 2024

All,

South Africa has brought a case against Israel in the Hague due to the
ongoing violence in Gaza. With all of the news coming out of the Hague, I
wanted to make it clear where I stand.

I believe the same thing I believed on Day 1 of this conflict: The path to
peace is diplomacy—not war.

I'm running for US Congress in IL-11 on the tenets of justice for all
people. That is why I have called for a ceasefire, an immediate release of
all hostages, and an end to the occupation and settlements from Day 1.
This requires upholding international human rights law, and demanding
justice and accountability for all parties involved—whether it's Hamas or
the Israeli government.

And to be sure, I have called for justice not just since October 7, but
for over a decade as a human rights lawyer. That is how we protect both
Israeli and Palestinian lives—both of which are sacred.

Sadly, my opponent Bill Foster still refuses to call for a ceasefire, and
instead continues to enable war as innocent people are killed. Hamas
killed 1,200 people and kidnapped approximately 250 more on October 7. The
response to war crimes is not more war crimes. Still, the Israeli military
has since killed 24,000 Palestinians—10,000 of them children. That is
beyond unacceptable.

We need leaders with the courage to demand justice for all. That is what I
have advocated for as a human rights lawyer for over a decade, and that is
my commitment to you as your next Congressman in Illinois' 11th District.

Let's get to work, because innocent people are suffering and dying, and
justice can't wait.

In solidarity,
Qasim

| | Greetings #TeamAlsobrooks, This week has been jam-packed with events to spread Angela’s message across the state! Thank you to everyone who came out to support us this week amidst the first snowfall of the season.
### **THIS WEEK ON THE CAMPAIGN TRAIL**
Angela spent time on Martin Luther King Jr. Day in Howard County with County Executive Calvin Ball, where they donated groceries to food banks throughout the county. Thank you to the ladies of Iota Lambda Omega Chapter of Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Inc, the men of Phi Beta Sigma Fraternity, Inc. and Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. for joining us and helping us give back to the community. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2571?t=7&akid=960%2E52803%2EzjpHm4) We also celebrated Martin Luther King Jr. Day, in Rockville, with the historic Iota Upsilon Lambda Chapter of Alpha Phi Alpha Fraternity, Inc. at their annual MLK Day celebration. It was great to spend time with so many friends reflecting on the importance of the day. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2571?t=8&akid=960%2E52803%2EzjpHm4) We continued the festivities with the Rho Xi Omega Chapter of Alpha Kappa Alpha Sorority, Inc. for their Founders Day/MLK gathering, where we discussed the power of sisterhood and reflected on Dr. King’s teachings and ideas. Dr. King’s life and legacy lives on today as we continue to fight for his dreams for America: justice and equity for all. [](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/2571?t=9&akid=960%2E52803%2EzjpHm4)
### **NEWS OF THE WEEK**
[**WUSA 9 Video - Candidate running for Senate in Maryland ramps up campaign efforts**](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9722?t=10&akid=960%2E52803%2EzjpHm4)**** _One of the candidates running for Senate in Maryland, Angela Alsobrooks, held an open house last night at her Senate Campaign Headquarters in Upper Marlboro._
### **CAMPAIGN UPDATES**
We’re extremely excited to announce that we’re accepting applications for our Fellowship Program aimed at high school and college students. If you know a young person looking to get some hands-on experience in politics, encourage [**them to apply here**](https://act.angelaalsobrooks.com/go/9750?t=11&akid=960%2E52803%2EzjpHm4). We have campaign offices now open in Largo and Silver Spring, with our new office in Baltimore opening next Friday! We’d love to have you join Team Alsobrooks in volunteering to help us get out the vote - **[sign up here if you’d like to join!](https://alsobrooks.actionkit.com/signup/volunteer-form?t=12&akid=960%2E52803%2EzjpHm4)** Here on Team Alsobrooks, we’re proud to be a campaign powered by grassroots donors. We believe in Angela's ability to go further and do better for our communities, and we know you do too! It’s going to take all of us working together to get Angela over the finish line this November. | | | [Volunteer](https://alsobrooks.actionkit.com/signup/volunteer-form?t=13&akid=960%2E52803%2EzjpHm4)

Dear Peter,
**__The Ukraine war should have never happened__** , and it's time we understand the complex web surrounding it.
**The Backstory:**
Russia tried multiple times to settle this conflict, wanting one key thing — to keep NATO out of Ukraine. However, the big military contractors had other plans. Adding new countries to NATO meant a captive market for specific companies like Northrop Grumman, Raytheon, General Dynamics, Boeing, and Lockheed.
**The Financial Toll:**
In March 2022, we committed a staggering $113 billion to the war in Ukraine. To put it in perspective, this could have provided homes for almost every homeless person in our country. But it doesn't end there. An additional $24 billion was committed two months ago, and now President Biden is seeking another $60 billion.
**The Money Trail:**
Senator Mitch McConnell recently revealed a startling truth — __its a money laundering scheme__. The funds aren't really going to Ukraine; they're going to American defense manufacturers, and who owns these companies? BlackRock.
**The Loan Illusion:**
Senator Tim Scott tried to ease concerns by calling the billions we’re giving away a loan. But it's not a generous offer; it's a tactic. By labeling it a loan, extreme austerity measures can be imposed on Ukraine. This includes putting government-owned assets up for sale to multinational corporations, __including its prized agricultural land__.
**The Land Grab:**
Ukraine's farmland, the breadbasket of Europe, is a major target. 30% of it has already been sold to Dupont, Cargill, and Monsanto — all entities owned by BlackRock.
**The Rebuilding Contract:**
In December, President Biden awarded the contract to rebuild Ukraine, and yes, you guessed it — BlackRock secured the deal.
**The Strategy:**
Their strategy is ancient but effective — keep us at war with each other. By fostering division, they maintain control.
They're doing all of this right in front of us because they believe they can get away with it. How do we stop them? [**We unite!**](https://www.kennedy24.com/donate?e=d33e868971601c1c714cfe0555abd394&utm_source=joinkennedy&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=ukraine_1_19_24_email_1_1_nd&n=2)
